4) The operating device of the excavator should meet the requirements of GB/T8595-2008 "Earth-moving Machinery Operating Device for Drivers".
5) The fuel tank capacity of excavators with a working mass of 6000 kg and above should ensure that the entire machine can operate continuously for no less than 10 hours.
(2) Performance requirements
1) The solid particle contamination level of the hydraulic system of the excavator should not exceed -/18/15 specified in GB/T14039-2002.
2) Under the test conditions specified in GB/T7586-2008 "Test Method for Hydraulic Excavators" (replaced by GB/T7586-2018), the displacement caused by internal leakage of the boom hydraulic cylinder piston rod should not exceed 25 mm/10 min.
3) No leakage should occur when the new machine leaves the factory.
4) The climbing ability of tire-type excavators should not be less than 35%, and that of crawler-type excavators should not be less than 50%.
5) The deviation of straight-line travel of crawler-type excavators should not exceed 5% of the measured distance.
6) Under the conditions specified in GB/T36693-2018 "Reliability Test Method, Failure Classification and Evaluation of Earth-moving Machinery Hydraulic Excavators", the reliability of the excavator should meet the following requirements:
① The mean time between failures of excavators with a working mass of 6000 kg and below should not be less than 300 hours, and that of excavators with a working mass of 6000 kg and above should not be less than 600 hours.
② The operational availability should not be less than 90%.
(3) Safety requirements
1) The excavator should be affixed with safety labels, which should meet the requirements of GB20178-2014 "General Provisions for Safety Labels of Earth-moving Machinery".
2) The driver's field of view should meet the requirements of GB/T16937-2010 "Test Method and Performance Criteria for the Driver's Field of View of Earth-moving Machinery". Excavators can be equipped with corresponding auxiliary equipment, such as rearview mirrors and monitoring devices, to supplement the inadequacy of the direct field of view. The field of view of rearview mirrors and monitoring devices should meet the requirements of GB/T25685.2-2010 "Field of View of Mirrors and Rearview Mirrors for Earth-moving Machinery Part 2: Performance Criteria".
3) The front window of the driver's cab should be equipped with a wiper and washer.
4) The electrical control system should have an overload protection device to ensure safety.
5) The excavator should meet the requirements of the mandatory provisions applicable in GB25684.5-2010 "Safety of Earth-moving Machinery Part 5: Requirements for Hydraulic Excavators".
6) The excavator should preferably meet the requirements of the recommended provisions applicable in GB25684.5-2010.
(4) Environmental protection and comfort requirements
1) If equipped with a fully enclosed driver's cab, the environment of the driver's cab should meet the requirements of GB/T19933.2-2014 "Driver's Cab Environment of Earth-moving Machinery Part 2: Air Filter Test Method", GB/T19933.4-2014 "Driver's Cab Environment of Earth-moving Machinery Part 4: Test Method and Performance of Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC)", and GB/T19933.5-2014 "Driver's Cab Environment of Earth-moving Machinery Part 5: Test Method for Defrosting System of Windshield".
2) The exhaust pollutants of the diesel engine of the excavator should meet the requirements of GB20891-2014 "Emission Limits and Measurement Methods for Exhaust Pollutants of Diesel Engines for Non-road Mobile Machinery (China Stage III and IV)".
3) The fuel consumption rate of the diesel engine of the excavator should meet the requirements of GB28239-2012 "Limits and Test Methods for Fuel Consumption Rate and Oil Consumption Rate of Off-road Diesel Engines".
4) If the excavator is equipped with an air conditioner, the refrigerant of the air conditioner should meet the requirements of GB/T18826-2016 "Industrial 1,1,1,2-Tetrafluoroethane (HFC-134a)".
5) The sound power level of the excavator's external sound emission and the sound pressure level of the sound emission at the driver's position should meet the requirements of GB16710-2010 "Noise Limits for Earth-moving Machinery".
6) Except for small excavators, the vibration reduction capability of the driver's seat of the excavator should meet the requirements of class EM6 input spectrum in GB/T8419-2007 "Laboratory Evaluation of Vibration of Driver's Seat of Earth-moving Machinery".
3. Test method
The test method should be carried out according to GB/T7586-2008 "Test Method for Hydraulic Excavators" (replaced by GB/T7586-2018).

In the type inspection items, the key items specified in Table 4-2 should all reach the requirements, and the number of nonconforming important items should not exceed 2 to be qualified.

4.1.6 Mobile Crane
A mobile crane is a type of crane that has its hoisting machinery mounted on a general-purpose or special-purpose automobile chassis, providing mobility performance similar to that of a heavy-duty vehicle. The terms, definitions, technical requirements, inspection rules, marking, packaging, transportation, and storage of mobile cranes are specified in JB/T 9738-2015 "Mobile Crane". This standard applies to hydraulic cranes powered by internal combustion engines (hereinafter referred to as cranes), and other types of cranes may also refer to its implementation.

1. Technical Requirements
(1) Operating Conditions
1) The ground where the crane is parked should be firm, and no sinking should occur during operation. If necessary, measures should be taken to meet the bearing capacity requirements. The bearing capacity of the ground (road) during travel should not be less than the ground pressure and axle load of the crane.
2) During testing, outriggers should be extended, all tires should be lifted off the ground, the entire machine should remain level, and the inclination of the slewing bearing installation plane should not exceed 1%.
3) The working pressure of the crane tires should comply with the regulations in the product manual, with an allowable error of ±5%.
4) The ambient temperature should be -20～40℃. If it is below -20℃, it should be stated in the purchase contract.
5) The wind speed at the work site should not exceed 14.1m/s. When the wind speed exceeds 15.5m/s, the auxiliary arm should be retracted; when the wind speed exceeds 20.0m/s, the entire boom should be retracted to the travel state.
6) When the boom length exceeds 50m and the user specifies the wind speed, the working wind speed shall be executed according to the contract.
7) The altitude should generally not exceed 2000m.
(2) Overall Machine (Only Related to Hydraulic Cylinders)
1) The design calculation of the crane should comply with the provisions of GB/T3811-2008 "Crane Design Specification".
2) The crane should meet the requirements for market access such as national mandatory certification and mandatory inspection of motor vehicles.
3) The maximum lifting capacity of the crane should comply with the provisions of GB/T7835-2013 "Lifting Machinery - Basic Types of Rated Lifting Capacities".
4) The stability of the crane as a whole should comply with the provisions of GB/T1992-2005 "Mobile Crane - Determination of Stability".
5) The rated lifting capacity table and working range should comply with the provisions of GB/T21458-2008 "Mobile Crane - Rated Lifting Capacity Chart".
6) The setting and debugging of safety devices for the crane should comply with the requirements of JB8716-1998 "Safety Regulations for Mobile Cranes and Tire Cranes" (already repealed).
7) Cranes with a maximum rated total lifting capacity greater than or equal to 8t should be equipped with an optional fixed auxiliary arm.
8) The operational reliability and travel reliability indicators of the crane should comply with the provisions in the product technical documents. The operational reliability test should comply with the provisions of JB/T4030.1-2013 "Test Specification for Mobile Cranes and Tire Cranes - Part 1: Operational Reliability Test", and the travel reliability test should comply with the provisions of JB/T4030.2-2013 "Test Specification for Mobile Cranes and Tire Cranes - Part 2: Travel Reliability Test".
9) The gas and liquid pipelines and electrical lines should be installed firmly and arranged neatly, and should not detach, loosen, or rub against each other during travel and hoisting operations; where mechanical damage may occur, they should be laid in grooves or pipes, and protective devices should be installed at the outlets to prevent wear.
10) Each control device should be easy to operate, flexible, and reliable, and should have indicator signs or markings. The signs or markings should comply with the provisions of GB4094-2016 "Signs for Vehicle Control Devices, Indicators, and Signal Devices", GB1505-2010 "Crane - Safety Signs and Hazard Symbol Diagrams - General Principles", and GB/T25195.2-2010 "Crane - Symbol Diagrams - Part 2: Mobile Crane".
11) Edges of parts that can be touched during normal use should be rounded (minimum radius of 2mm) or chamfered (minimum 2mm×2mm).
12) The paint should be smooth and uniform, without defects such as missing paint, peeling, falling off, or inconsistent color; the main exposed surfaces should be free of defects such as flow marks and bubbles. The adhesion of the paint film should meet the requirements of first-class quality specified in GB/T9286-1998 "Paints and Varnishes - Cross-cut Test for Film Adhesion".
13) Exposed pin shafts, valve blocks, and other metal surfaces should be treated for corrosion and rust prevention.
14) The maximum working speed of the crane's hydraulic pump should be limited according to design requirements, and its value should not exceed the rated speed of the hydraulic pump.
15) The operating parameters of the crane should meet the design values provided by the manufacturer.
16) The main dimensions and weight of the crane should not be greater than their limit values, and the deviation of the mass parameter should not be greater than 3%.
17) The manufacturer should clearly state in the instruction manual whether the crane has the capability of telescoping with load.
18) For cranes with special requirements, they may be executed according to the contract.
(3) Mechanisms and Components (Only Related to Hydraulic Cylinders)
1) Luffing Mechanism
① The luffing mechanism should be able to reliably support the boom and make the boom stop smoothly at any position under the control of the operator; when the operator does not operate, it should be able to support the boom and the rated load.
② When a hydraulic luffing mechanism is used, the design of the connecting device between the two hydraulic cylinders that perform synchronous actions should be able to avoid overload of one of the hydraulic cylinders.
2) Telescoping Mechanism
① The telescoping mechanism should be able to reliably support each extended boom section, make the crane boom extend and retract smoothly to the predetermined boom length under the control of the operator, and effectively control the rated load.
② A holding device (such as a 0 2 5 Hydraulic Cylinder Manual) should be installed on the telescoping hydraulic cylinder.
532:
(2) Hydraulic valve (balance valve), in case of accidental failure of hydraulic system (such as pipe rupture), to prevent uncontrolled retraction of boom.

(3) Telescopic mechanism of single-cylinder pin-insertion type. The length of each section of boom should not be less than 2 arm positions. The telescopic mechanism of single-cylinder pin-insertion type should be able to control the working pressure of hydraulic cylinder according to the load state of telescopic cylinder. Hydraulic cylinder, arm pin and cylinder pin should have mechanical interlocking device.

(4) Hydraulic system

1) The design, manufacture, installation and piping of hydraulic system should conform to the provisions of GB/T3766.

2) Hydraulic components should be able to work normally without failure under the maximum working pressure (including the pressure during overload test) and maximum running speed. Hydraulic components should conform to the provisions of GB/T7935.

3) Hydraulic pump and hydraulic motor should be able to withstand the change of various loads in operation. Hydraulic system should be equipped with limit load adjustment function. The starting point of variable motor should be at the maximum displacement. The automatic switching from small displacement to large displacement should be possible.

4) During the stability test of hydraulic circuit, the operation should be stable without vibration. Each hydraulic circuit should be equipped with a device showing pressure or a detection port. The accuracy of pressure gauge should not be lower than Class 1.6.

5) When the hydraulic pump is at the rated speed (flow rate), the pressure of hydraulic system should conform to the design requirements. When the hydraulic pump is running stably at the designed speed (flow rate), the actual working pressure of each hydraulic circuit should not be greater than the rated working pressure of hydraulic pump. The set pressure of safety relief valve should not be greater than 110% of the rated working pressure of system.

6) Anti-wear and viscosity-temperature hydraulic oil should be selected for crane, and it should be clearly specified in the product manual. The pollution grade, measurement method, selection and replacement of hydraulic oil solid particles should conform to the provisions of JB/T9737-2013 "Hydraulic Oil Solid Particle Pollution Grade, Measurement and Selection for Mobile Crane".

7) During the operation of hydraulic system, the highest oil temperature in hydraulic oil tank should not exceed 80℃. When the temperature rise test is finished, the relative temperature rise of hydraulic oil in oil tank should not be greater than 45℃.

8) During the normal operation of crane (including the performance test process), there should be no oil leakage in hydraulic system. During the sealing performance test, after 15 minutes, the retraction amount of luffing hydraulic cylinder and vertical leg hydraulic cylinder should not be greater than 2mm, and the sinking amount of heavy object should not be greater than 15mm; the fixed joint surface of crane should not seep oil, and the relative moving parts should not drip oil. No oil film can be felt by hand or no oil stain can be seen by naked eye is regarded as no oil seepage; the area of oil stain oozing out should not be greater than 100cm2 or no oil drop should appear is regarded as no oil dripping.

9) The safety factor of hydraulic steel pipe and joint should not be less than 2.5.

10) Hydraulic hose should conform to the provisions of JB/T8727. The safety factor should not be less than 4. When the working pressure of hydraulic hose is greater than 5MPa or the temperature is higher than 50℃, and the distance from operator is less than 1m without any other shelter, protective measures should be taken to prevent the operator from being injured by the bursting of hose.

11) The vacuum degree at the suction port of gear pump should not be greater than 0.03MPa. The vacuum degree at the suction port of piston pump should not be greater than 0.02MPa.

12) Hydraulic cylinder should be equipped with a device which can stop its action when the hydraulic pipeline bursts accidentally (such as hydraulic lock, balance valve, etc.). The device should be as close to hydraulic cylinder as possible and adopt rigid connection. If the welded or ferrule joint is installed between hydraulic cylinder and hydraulic valve, the safety factor of the whole structure should not be less than 2.5.

13) A safety warning sign should be marked on the accumulator or at a prominent position near the accumulator.

14) Filter should be equipped with blocking detection or alarm device.

15) Hydraulic oil tank should be equipped with liquid level indicator, and the "highest" and "lowest" marks allowed by the system should be made.

2. Test method and inspection rules

The test method and inspection rules of crane should be carried out according to the provisions of GB/T6068-2008 "Test Code for Truck Crane and Tyre Crane".

1) The paver should be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.
2) The materials and supporting parts (outsourced parts) used in the paver should have the necessary qualified certificates.
3) The paver should have a feeding system, conveying device, distributing device, leveling and heating device, walking system and operating control system. The structural layout should be convenient for maintenance and repair, and the parts that require frequent inspection, lubrication, adjustment and fastening should have sufficient working space, and the minimum entrance size should comply with the provisions of G B / T1 7 2 9 9—1 9 9 8 "Minimum Entrance Dimensions for Earthmoving Machinery".
4) The normal working conditions of the paver should comply with the following regulations:
① The working environment temperature of the paver should generally be within the range of 4 to 35 ℃; the altitude should be below 500 m.
② The asphalt pavement base course, asphalt mixture, etc. used by the paver should comply with the provisions of G B5 0 0 9 2—1 9 9 6 "Technical Specifications for Asphalt Pavement Construction and Acceptance".
5) The paver should be able to pave the surface layer of asphalt mixture pavement in various working combination states under the condition of receiving materials from the supporting equipment specified by the product.
6) The paver should be equipped with a special device, tool box, special tools, common spare parts and accessories for hoisting and transportation.
7) The outer boundary dimensions in the transportation state should comply with the relevant regulations on transportation and transportation.
8) The welding quality and casting quality of the paver should comply with J G / T 5 0 8 2 . 1—1 9 9 6 "General Technical Conditions for Welded Parts of Construction Machinery and Equipment", J G / T5 0 1 1 . 1—1 9 9 2 "General Technical Conditions for Cast Steel Parts of Construction Machinery and Equipment" (has been abolished), J G / T5 0 1 1 . 5—1 9 9 2 "General Technical Conditions for Nodular Cast Iron Parts of Construction Machinery and Equipment" (has been abolished); the surface and edges of sheet metal parts and structural parts should be smooth and flat.
9) The painting quality and assembly of the paver should comply with the provisions of J G / T 5 0 1 1 . 1 2—1 9 9 2 "General Technical Conditions for Painting of Construction Machinery and Equipment" (has been abolished) and J G / T 5 0 1 1 . 1 1—1 9 9 2 "General Technical Conditions for Assembly of Construction Machinery and Equipment" (has been abolished), respectively.
10) Reliability requirements for pavers: The reliability test time for the whole paver is 300 h; the working time before the first failure is not less than 100 h; the average trouble-free working time is not less than 100 h; the reliability is not less than 85%.
(2) Automatic leveling system
1) The automatic leveling system should adopt mechanical contact or non-contact sensors, and the response characteristics of the electro-hydraulic control system should meet the requirements of paving surface smoothness.
2) The working position indicators of the piston rod of the hydraulic cylinders on both sides of the automatic leveling should be obvious.
3) The working environment temperature of the automatic leveling controller should be -10 to 70.
Note: The "smoothness" index of the paving quality is shown in Table 6 of G B / T1 6 2 7 7—2 0 0 8.
(3) Hydraulic system
1) The hydraulic system should comply with the relevant provisions of G B / T 3 7 6 6.
2) The oil temperature of the hydraulic system is not more than 85.
3) The cleanliness level of solid particle pollution of hydraulic oil in the open hydraulic system should not be greater than 18/15 specified in J G / T5 0 3 5—1 9 9 3 "Classification of Cleanliness of Oil Liquid Solid Pollution for Construction Machinery and Equipment" (has been abolished), and the closed system should not be greater than 17/14.
4) The hydraulic system should have good sealing performance, and there should be no leakage or air inhalation.
(4) Electronic management system
1) The electronic management system should be able to monitor and display the main working parameters of each working device in real time during the paving process.
2) The electronic management system should be able to monitor and alarm the faults in real time, and at the same time display the fault location, possible causes and solutions, and shut down for protection according to the severity of the faults.
3) The electronic management system should be able to set and store the relevant data of the working process, and output statistical data.
4) The electronic management system should have optional functions of wireless data transmission and remote control.
5) The electronic management system can provide instructions and help for the use, maintenance and maintenance of the paver as needed.

4.1.9 Hydraulic Pile Hammer
The hydraulic pile hammer uses an engine (motor) to drive a hydraulic pump that delivers stable high-pressure oil to the hydraulic cylinder. The hammer core is lifted by the hydraulic cylinder or hoisted to a set height and then falls to generate impact force to strike the pile body. JB/T 13566-2018 "Construction Machinery and Equipment - Hydraulic Pile Driver" specifies the terms and definitions, basic parameters, classification, models and specifications, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, operating instructions, marking, packaging, transportation, and storage of hydraulic pile hammers. It is applicable to hydraulic pile hammers.

2. Technical Requirements

(1) General Requirements

3) The outsourced and purchased parts used in the hydraulic pile hammer should have inspection certificates and can be put into installation only after passing acceptance inspection.
4) All pipelines and cables of the hydraulic pile hammer should be neatly arranged, reliably fixed, and free from wear and interference.
5) The hydraulic pile hammer should be able to work normally under environmental temperature conditions of -15 to 45°C.
6) Welded parts should meet the requirements of JB/T 5934.

(5) Appearance requirements

The reliability test time for the hydraulic pile hammer should not be less than 200 h, with a reliability not less than 85%, an average time between failures not less than 80 h, and a time before the first failure not less than 100 h.
4.2 Design and selection basis for hydraulic cylinders used in hydraulic presses
A hydraulic press is a general term for presses driven by hydraulic transmission, or can be described as a general term for presses that use hydraulic transmission to drive the slider or working components. It is divided into hydraulic presses and hydraulic presses according to the medium. Usually, a hydraulic press refers to a press driven by hydraulic pressure. For some hydraulic presses specified in standards, see Table 4-10. Although there are various differences, the hydraulic system and hydraulic cylinder are components of the hydraulic presses specified in the standards.
A CNC hydraulic press is a hydraulic press that mainly uses digital quantities for information transmission and control, has a man-machine interface, and adopts digital control for main parameters (at least including pressure and displacement parameters). However, its type should comply with GB/T28761—2012 "Forging Machinery Type Designation Method".
In various hydraulic press standards, the type and basic parameters, (technical) requirements, etc., of hydraulic presses are generally given, which are the basis for designing and selecting hydraulic cylinders used in hydraulic presses. Some detailed (or specific) technical requirements are even mandatory for hydraulic cylinders specially designed for that type of hydraulic press.

2) In addition to meeting the requirements of drawings and technical documents, the electric power transmission and control system shall also comply with the relevant provisions of GB 5 2 2 6 . 1.

(2) Structural requirements
1) The rotating material chamber shall be able to rotate 90° as specified, and ensure the positioning requirements of the material chamber in horizontal or vertical positions.
2) Nozzles and nozzle sleeves of various specifications shall be interchangeable.
3) The heating device for the nozzle sleeve and nozzle type shall be able to reach the required working temperature.
4) The vacuum chamber shall be tightly combined with the material chamber, and the sealing structure shall meet the specified vacuum degree requirements during vacuum extraction.
5) The extruded electrode shall be cut to the required length and the corresponding cooling time shall be selected according to different specifications of the electrode.
6) The flatness of the cut electrode end face shall be less than 6 mm.
7) The operation program compiled by the PLC programmable controller shall meet the requirements for normal and safe operation of the equipment. Signals from misoperations shall not be responded to (except for the emergency stop button).
8) The impact of electrode specification changes on production capacity can be compensated by changing the extrusion parameters.

(3) Safety requirements
1) The extruder shall be equipped with mechanical safety devices to ensure the personal safety of operators.
2) Both the electrical control and hydraulic systems shall have overload and interlock safety protection devices.
3) The heating elements of the nozzle, material chamber and extrusion head shall be safe and reliable. Pipes and joints heated with heat transfer oil shall not leak. Heating elements heated electrically shall be reliably insulated. When measured with a 500 V megohmmeter, the insulation resistance value shall not be less than 0.5 MΩ.
4) The noise value of the extruder during operation shall not be greater than 85 dB(A).

(4) Assembly precision requirements
1) After assembly, the flatness of the upper plane of the extruder base shall be 0.1/1000.
2) The shoulder of the main cylinder, the nut of the tension rod and the end faces of the front and rear crossbeams shall be tightly fitted. When checked with a 0.08 mm feeler gauge, the insertion depth shall not exceed 10 mm, and the cumulative insertion length shall not be greater than 10% of the circumference.
3) When the extrusion head moves within the full length of the material chamber, there shall be no rubbing against the sides. The allowable gap in the vertical direction can be adjusted to be tight on top and loose on bottom at the outer end of the material chamber, and tight on bottom and loose on top at the bottom of the material chamber, but the minimum single-sided gap shall be greater than 0.2 mm.

(5) Completeness
1) The extruder shall include the main body, hydraulic station, cutting device, electrical control system, vacuum extraction device, etc. The cylindrical cooling machine, nozzle replacement machine, and cooling roller conveyor can be optionally configured. The scope of supply shall be as specified in the purchase contract.
2) Supporting parts (including motors, hydraulic pumps, vacuum devices, hydraulic and electrical components, and sealing parts, etc.) shall comply with the current relevant standards and have obtained their qualification certificates.
3) Spare parts shall be provided as specified in the contract.

(6) Reliability and service life
1) The service life of the extruder under specified usage conditions shall not be less than 3000 h.
2) The cumulative working time from the start of use to the first major overhaul of the extruder shall not be less than 15000 h.

Note:
1) Before designing and selecting hydraulic cylinders for hydraulic presses, it is essential to clearly and accurately understand the usage conditions of the hydraulic cylinders. The adjustment range of the hydraulic cylinder and the slide block it drives is very important.
2) The durability requirement for hydraulic cylinders may differ from the reliability and service life requirement for hydraulic presses, but generally the service life of hydraulic cylinders for hydraulic presses should be comparable to that of the hydraulic press.
3) The completeness of hydraulic presses is specified, and the sealing parts of hydraulic cylinders in the supporting parts are very important.

4.2.1.1 Hydraulic Press for Magnetic Materials
The terms "hydraulic press for magnetic materials" and their definitions are not found in GB/T8541-2012, GB/T3648-2018, JB/T4174-2014, and JB/T6584-1993. JB/T6584-1993 specifies the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, marking, and transportation for hydraulic presses for magnetic material products (hereinafter referred to as magnetic material presses).
1. Technical Requirements
(1) Drawing and Technical Document Requirements
Magnetic material presses should be manufactured according to the approved drawings and technical documents.
(2) Type and Basic Parameters
The type and basic parameters of magnetic material presses should comply with the corresponding standards.
(3) Complete Set Requirements
1) Magnetic material presses are generally equipped with corresponding auxiliary devices.
① Auxiliary devices for wet forming. Including automatic slurry delivery device, magnetizing/demagnetizing device, vacuum water extraction device, and universal mold frame.
② Auxiliary devices for dry forming. Including powder feeding device, magnetizing/demagnetizing device, and universal mold frame.
2) Magnetic material presses should be equipped with necessary tools, accessories, and wearing parts, ensuring their performance and interchangeability. The supply of special accessories is to be negotiated between the supplier and the demander.
(4) Requirements for Purchased Supporting Parts
The quality of purchased supporting parts for magnetic material presses should comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards. They should undergo running tests simultaneously with the whole machine upon leaving the factory.
(5) Safety and Protection
1) Magnetic material presses should have reliable safety and protection devices for operators. Protection devices should comply with the requirements of JB3915 (already abolished).
2) Magnetic material presses should have reliable overload and overtravel protection devices.
3) Magnetic material presses should be equipped with emergency stop and devices to prevent power-driven operation when unexpected voltage returns.
(6) Performance of the Press
1) Magnetic material presses should have floating pressing and bidirectional pressing process actions.
2) The pressure and stroke of magnetic material presses can be adjusted according to process requirements.
3) The pressing speed of magnetic material presses should be adjustable within the range specified in the design documents.
4) The sliding friction pairs of magnetic material presses should take wear-resistant measures and have a reasonable hardness difference.
5) The operation of magnetic material presses must be sensitive, reliable, and stable. Hydraulic actuators (such as pistons and plungers) should not exhibit vibration, crawling, or jamming phenomena within the specified stroke speed range. Reversing should not have impact phenomena affecting normal operation.
6) Magnetic material presses should have continuous pressing capability, and the continuous pressing time should be adjustable.
7) The coordinated and reliable operation of the press and its supporting auxiliary devices should be ensured.
8) The rigidity of magnetic material presses should comply with relevant standards or design requirements.
9) The noise limit of magnetic material presses should comply with the provisions of ZBJ62006.1 (already abolished), and the measurement method should follow the provisions of JB362 (already abolished).
10) The accuracy of magnetic material presses should not be lower than the provisions of GB/T9166-2009.
(7) Performance of Supporting Devices
1) Automatic slurry delivery device.
2) Automatic powder feeding device.
3) Vacuum water extraction device.
4) Magnetizing/demagnetizing device.
5) Requirements for universal mold frame.

1) All castings, forgings, and welded parts on the magnetic material press shall comply with the provisions of the standards and the technical requirements of the drawings and process documents. 2) The working surfaces of important castings shall not have defects such as pores, shrinkage cavities, sand holes, slag inclusions, and segregation.

3) Important castings, forgings, and welded parts shall be subjected to stress relief treatment.

4) The hardness of the same guide rail surface after machining shall be uniform, and the hardness difference shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 3818—2014.

(9) Assembly Quality

1) The magnetic material press shall be assembled according to the assembly process specifications. No damaged parts, their surfaces, or the lips of seals shall be assembled. After assembly, the actions of each mechanism shall be flexible, accurate, and reliable.

2) Important fixed mating surfaces shall be tightly fitted. After being firmly pre-tightened, they shall be inspected using a 0.05 mm feeler gauge. Local insertion is allowed, and the cumulative insertion portion shall not exceed 10% of the inspectable length.

① The fixed mating surface between the column shoulder and the worktable.
② The fixed mating surface between the column adjustment nut, locknut, and the upper beam and worktable.
③ The fixed mating surface between the hydraulic cylinder locknut and the upper beam.
④ The fixed mating surface between the piston shoulder and the slider.

3) Before assembly, the inner surfaces of the pipelines and channels of the hydraulic and cooling systems, and the oil tank shall be thoroughly treated for rust prevention and decontamination.

4) All pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed and movable connections shall be reliably connected, well sealed, and free from leakage.

③ A magnetic filter shall be installed in the hydraulic system of the magnetic material press.
④ The cleanliness of the hydraulic system of the magnetic material press shall comply with the provisions of ZBJ 6200.1 (now obsolete).

2) The pneumatic device shall comply with the provisions of Article 5.3 in JB/T 1829—2014.
3) The electrical equipment shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 5226.1—2008 (2019).

① The appearance quality of the magnetic material press shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 3818—2014.

(1) Testing Conditions for the Magnetic Material Press
1) Before testing, the press shall be leveled, and the levelness of the worktable in the longitudinal and transverse directions shall not be greater than 0.20/1000.
2) The matching auxiliary devices shall be tested together with the press.
3) Testing shall be conducted under normal conditions of voltage, hydraulic pressure, air pressure, and lubrication.

(2) Performance Testing
1) Starting and Stopping Test. It shall be conducted continuously for no less than 3 times, and the action shall be sensitive and reliable.
2) Sliding Operation Test. It shall be conducted continuously for no less than 3 times, and the action shall be stable and reliable.
3) Slider Stroke Adjustment Test. It shall be adjusted to the maximum stroke length, and the action shall be accurate and reliable.
4) Slider Stroke Limiter Test. It can generally be combined with the slider stroke adjustment test, and the action shall be accurate and reliable.
5) Slider Stroke Speed Test. It shall be tested at the maximum empty stroke speed, and the action shall be accurate and reliable. The stroke speed shall comply with the provisions of relevant standards or technical documents.
6) Pressure Adjustment Test. The pressure shall be debugged in stages from low pressure to high pressure, and the pressure at each stage shall be stable and reliable.
7) Matching Auxiliary Device Test. The actions of the slurry automatic delivery device, vacuum water absorption device, magnetizing and demagnetizing device, universal mold frame, and other matching auxiliary devices shall be coordinated, accurate, and reliable.
8) Sustained Pressure Test. The pressure shall be maintained for 10 s at the rated system pressure, the pressure shall be stable, and the pressure deviation shall not be greater than ±0.8 MPa.
9) Safety Device Test. It shall be combined with the machine performance test, and the action shall be safe and reliable.
10) Safety Valve Test. It shall be combined with the load test, and the action test shall be conducted for no less than 3 times. The action shall be sensitive and reliable.

4.2.12 Six-sided top hydraulic press for superhard materials

The terms and definitions of "six-sided top hydraulic press for superhard materials" are not included in GB/T8541-2012, GB/T3684-2018, JB/T4174-2014, and JB/T8779-2014. JB/T8779-2014 stipulates the model and basic parameters, accuracy, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, and storage of the six-sided top hydraulic press for superhard materials, which is applicable to six-sided top hydraulic presses for superhard materials with mineral oil as the transmission medium, driven by a single pump (or with a booster), hereinafter referred to as the press.

1. Model and basic parameters

1) The model name of the press should comply with GB/T28761.

2) The parameters and dimensions of the press should adopt the parameters and dimensions approved through the prescribed procedures.

2. Accuracy

1) The accuracy inspection of the press should comply with GB/T10923.

2) Before the accuracy inspection, the installation level of the press should be adjusted. On the flange surface of the lower hydraulic cylinder of the press, a level should be placed along two perpendicular directions, and the reading of the level should not be greater than 0.20/1000.

3) Special inspection tools and accuracy inspection can be found in JB/T8779-2014.

3. Technical requirements

(1) General requirements

1) The press should comply with JB/T1829, and should be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved through the prescribed procedures.

2) The design and layout should consider the requirements of process aesthetics, the appearance should be beautiful, and it should be convenient for use, maintenance, assembly, disassembly, and transportation.

3) Spare parts and accessories should be interchangeable and should comply with the relevant standards and technical documents.

4) The accompanying technical documents include the product inspection certificate, packing list, and product instruction manual. The product instruction manual should comply with GB/T9969, and its content should include an introduction to performance and structure, installation, transportation, storage, use, and safety.

5) The disassembled parts and hydraulic components should have corresponding identification marks. The pipe ports and channel ports of hydraulic components should have dust-proof measures.

(2) Stiffness

The press should have sufficient stiffness and should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.

(3) Wear-resistant measures

Important friction pairs (such as cylinders, sleeves, pistons) should take necessary wear-resistant measures and comply with the provisions of the technical documents.

(4) Safety protection

1) The safety protection of the press should comply with GB28241. Whether it is the design and selection of the structure, components, and hydraulic system, as well as their application, configuration, adjustment, and control, consideration should be given to ensuring personal safety under various usage and maintenance conditions.

2) On the main machine and its molds (top hammers) in the ultra-high-pressure working area, the buyer should set up personal safety protection devices, such as protective plates (walls). If the supplier needs to provide them, it should be noted in the contract or agreement.

3) The buyer should formulate a regular inspection, replacement, and scrapping system for the ultra-high-pressure parts of the press to ensure the safe operation of the press.

4) An over-travel protection device should be installed on the main machine and the booster to prevent accidents.

5) The exposed windows on the main machine should have protective plates, and the exposed couplings should have protective covers.

6) Parts that may automatically fall off, such as pins, should have anti-falling-off devices.

7) Single-direction rotating motors should mark arrows indicating the direction of rotation in obvious places.

8) The selection of all hydraulic components should not exceed the technical specifications specified for those components.

9) The relevant components affecting safety in the hydraulic system should be equipped with safety protection devices such as overload protection and over-travel protection [such as safety valves, over-travel buzzers, warning indicator lights, and automatic power-off devices for the electrical system, etc.].

10) The hydraulic circuit and electrical circuit should prevent uncontrolled movement and abnormal action sequences under conditions such as the starting, stopping, idling, adjustment, and hydraulic faults of the executing elements.

11) When the press is shut down, it should be able to automatically release the hydraulic pressure or reliably cut off from the hydraulic system. For gas accumulators, they should be filled with nitrogen or other inert gases, kept away from heat sources, and installed vertically.

12) The noise should not exceed the provisions of GB26484.

(5) Cast and forged parts

1) The cast steel parts of the press should comply with the provisions of the technical documents. Defects that do not affect safe use, service life, and appearance can be repaired according to relevant regulations, provided that the quality is guaranteed.

2) Important cast and forged parts (such as hinge beams, working cylinders, booster cylinders, ultra-high-pressure cylinders, and working pistons) should undergo stress relief treatment.

(6) Machining

1) The quality of machined parts should comply with the provisions of the design drawings and technical documents, and there should be no defects that reduce the safe use of the press or affect its appearance.

2) The machined surfaces should not have defects such as rust, burrs, bumps, and scratches.

3) The quality grade of non-planar defects on the hinge ear side of cast steel parts is Grade 1 as specified in GB72332-2010, and the quality grade of non-planar defects on the remaining parts and other cast steel parts is Grade 2 as specified in GB72332-2010.

(7) Assembly
1) During sub-assembly and final assembly, parts such as gaskets not shown in the drawing should not be installed.
2) The important fixed mating surfaces of the press should be tightly fitted. Using a 0.05 mm feeler gauge for inspection, the depth of insertion should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface, and the cumulative length of insertion should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference.
3) The press should be assembled according to the assembly process. The clearance between the six pistons and the cylinder body should be selected within the processing range during assembly to ensure that the difference in assembly clearance is less than 0.05 mm. Parts and their surfaces, as well as seals, should not be damaged due to assembly. All assembled parts (including purchased and outsourced parts) should meet quality requirements.
4) The internal surfaces of the pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed and movable connections of the hydraulic system and cooling system should be thoroughly treated for rust and dirt removal before assembly.
5) All pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed and movable connections should be reliably connected, well sealed, and free from leakage.

4. Test Methods

(1) General Requirements

1) The press should be installed and adjusted before inspection, and its installation level should comply with the accuracy requirements.
2) During the inspection process, structural parts and components that affect the performance and accuracy of the press should not be adjusted. Otherwise, the test should be repeated.
3) The inspection should be carried out on the assembled whole machine. Except for the parts specified in the standard or technical document that need to be disassembled during the inspection, other parts should not be disassembled.
4) The power supply should be normal during the inspection.
5) All actuators of the press should be connected during the inspection.

(2) Basic Performance Inspection

It should be carried out in combination with the no-load test and load test. The general performance inspection methods are as follows:

1) Starting and stopping inspection. It should be carried out continuously for no less than three times, and the action should be sensitive and reliable.
2) Operation test of the main engine and booster piston. It should be carried out continuously for no less than three tests, and the action should be flexible and reliable.
3) Limit adjustment test of the main engine piston stroke. It should be adjusted within the piston stroke range, and the action should be accurate and reliable.
4) Main engine piston stroke speed adjustment test. It should be adjusted according to the maximum no-load stroke speed specified, and the action should be accurate and reliable, and comply with the relevant standards or technical documents.
5) Pressure adjustment test. According to the provisions of the technical document, it should be measured in stages from low pressure to high pressure. The pressure test results at each pressure level should be stable and reliable.
6) Safety device test. Action tests such as emergency stop and emergency pressure relief, and prevention of automatic connection of electric drive devices when unexpected voltage is restored should all be safe and reliable.
7) Safety valve test. It should be combined with overload test, and the number of action tests should be no less than three times. The results should be flexible and reliable.

(3) No-load Test

1) The press piston should undergo a no-load test with full reciprocating motion. The continuous no-load test time should be no less than 4 hours. During type inspection, the continuous no-load test time for each test should be no less than 8 hours, and the cumulative continuous no-load test time should be no less than 68 hours.
2) After the no-load test, measure the oil temperature in the oil tank (or the temperature at the inlet of the hydraulic pump). Record the temperature when it reaches a stable value. The temperature should not be higher than 60°C.
3) During the no-load test process, check the working conditions of each mechanism;
① Check the correctness and smoothness of the actuator movement.
② Check all high-pressure and low-pressure hydraulic systems, cooling systems, etc. The pipes, joints, flanges, and other connecting seams should be well sealed, and there should be no oil or water leakage or mutual mixing.
③ Check whether all indicating devices are accurate and reliable.

(4) Load Test

1) After the press passes the no-load test, it should undergo a full load test.
2) Pressure regulation test: Increase the pressure in stages according to the specified pressure levels, and the operation should be stable and reliable. Check the temperature rise and leakage to comply with the regulations.
3) Under the rated pressure, the continuous operation test should be no less than 15 hours. Check the temperature rise of the system, leakage, nominal force, and the current of the main motor, which should comply with the regulations.
4) Perform a pressure holding test under the rated pressure, and the pressure drop should comply with the provisions of Table 4-34.
5) The work of each mechanism should be normal during the load test.

(5) Overload Test

The overload test should be carried out with the safety valve adjusted to 1.1 times the rated pressure, and the number of times should be no less than three times. The parts of the press should not have any damage or permanent deformation, and the hydraulic system should not have leakage or other abnormal phenomena.

Explanation:
1) Although the pressure test pressure for hydraulic cylinders in JB/T8779-2014 is contradictory to the pressure test pressure for the shells of self-made hydraulic components, it has important reference value for hydraulic cylinders used in hydraulic presses with a nominal (or rated) pressure greater than 31.5 MPa.
2) In JB/T8779-2014: "When designing a hydraulic system, necessary measures should be taken to ensure that the oil temperature in the oil tank (or the temperature at the inlet of the hydraulic pump) is 15-60°C." This is more explicit than the statements in other standards.
3) The pressure holding performance (pressure holding accuracy) of the press in JB/T8779-2014 also has certain reference value.

2. Technical Requirements

(1) General Technical Requirements

1) The hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of standard JB/T7343-2010 and should be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.

2) The scope of supply for the hydraulic press includes: the main body, hydraulic transmission and control device, electrical transmission and control device, lubrication system and devices, necessary special tools, and vulnerable parts that should be included with the machine. Spare parts and special accessories are not included. Users can negotiate with the manufacturer for spare parts to be supplied with the machine or separately. The content of supply is executed according to the contract.

3) The purchased supporting parts for the hydraulic press should comply with the current standards.

4) The factory technical documents should be provided with the products leaving the factory. The technical documents provided with the machine should be packed in the packing box, including:

① Product quality certificate.

② Product instruction manual.

③ Drawings for installation, maintenance, and vulnerable parts.

④ Packing list.

5) Under the conditions of correct use and normal maintenance and upkeep, the working hours from the beginning of use to the first overhaul of the hydraulic press should not be less than 28000 hours.

6) The performance of the hydraulic press should be good, use should be reliable, and operation should be flexible.

7) The working environment temperature of the hydraulic press is 5-40°C, relative humidity is ≤70%, and altitude is below 1000 meters. If the environmental conditions do not meet the above requirements, users should indicate when placing the order.

8) Under the conditions of normal transportation, storage, installation, adjustment, use, and maintenance and upkeep of the hydraulic press, if the hydraulic press is damaged or cannot work normally due to manufacturing defects within the time specified in Table 4-4-1, the manufacturer is responsible for free repair or replacement of parts (except vulnerable parts) for the user. The time is calculated based on whichever comes first.

(4) No damage shall occur to the sealing element. Before assembly, grease shall be applied to the sealing element and the sealing surface. When assembling overlapping sealing rings, they shall be pressed against each other, and the opening shall face the side with higher pressure.
(5) The straightness error of the guide rail of the pressing head on the machine body shall not be greater than 1 mm/1000 mm, and the full length shall not exceed 5 mm. The parallelism error of the guide rails on both sides shall not be greater than 2 mm/1000 mm, and the full length shall not exceed 6 mm.
(6) Before assembly, the channel of the pipeline and the inner surface of the oil tank in the hydraulic system shall be treated for rust prevention and decontamination. No dirt shall be allowed to exist. The cleanliness of the hydraulic system shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
(7) All pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed connections and sealing parts shall be reliably connected and well sealed, and no leakage shall be allowed.
5) Hydraulic system.
(1) The hydraulic system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766.
(2) The hydraulic cylinder must undergo a pressure test, and the pressure holding time shall not be less than 10 min, and no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage shall occur. The pressure test pressure shall be 1.2 times the rated working pressure.
(3) Various valves in the hydraulic system shall be sensitive in action and reliable in operation.
(4) The cooling system shall meet the requirements for the temperature and temperature rise of the hydraulic oil. It shall be ensured that the oil temperature at the oil inlet in the oil tank shall not exceed 60°C during normal operation.
(5) No leakage shall occur in the hydraulic system and the cooling system.
(6) The cleanliness of the hydraulic system shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
6) Noise. When the baler is running idle, its noise limit shall comply with the provisions of GB 2648.
7) Electrical system.
(1) The electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(2) The continuity of the protective grounding circuit of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(3) The grounding protection and insulation resistance of the electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(4) The withstand voltage performance of the electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
8) Safety and protection.
(1) The design and manufacture of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 17120.
(2) After the hydraulic pump of the baler is started, the working parts must not move without pressing the working button.
(3) The hydraulic system shall be equipped with a safety device to prevent hydraulic overload.
(4) The pressure gauge of the hydraulic system shall be installed in a place where it is easy for the operator to observe. Protective measures and necessary signal displays shall be provided for sudden pressure loss or interruption.
(5) The safety and protection of the electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
9) Appearance and painting.
(1) No protrusions, depressions, roughness, and other damages not specified in the drawing shall occur on the outer surface of the baler. The joint surfaces shall be flat, and no obvious gaps and misalignments shall occur.
(2) No defects such as knocks, scratches, and rust shall occur on the exposed machined surfaces. No defects such as twisting and hammering shall occur at the ends of all kinds of fasteners.
(3) The exposed weld seams shall be smooth and uniform.
(4) The hydraulic pipelines and electrical lines shall be arranged neatly and fixed firmly, and shall not touch the parts with relative motion.
(5) The nameplates and various signs shall be flat and upright.
(6) The coating surface of the baler shall be flat and the color shall be uniform. No defects such as sagging and bottom exposure shall occur. The paints of different colors shall have clear boundaries and shall not pollute each other.
(7) Other unpainted surfaces of the baler (except for the surfaces in direct contact with the processed materials) shall be treated for rust prevention by applying anti-rust oil, and shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 4879.
(8) Adjusting bolts and nuts that need to be frequently rotated shall not be painted.

(1) The inspection of basic parameters shall be carried out during the no-load running test and the load running test. The inspection of working pressure and working speed may be carried out during the load running test.

4.2.1.9 Hydraulic press for fluid forming
Although there are many similarities between JB/T12098-2014 and JB/T12099-2014, and there are repeated expressions in each standard, such as the requirements for nameplates and instruction manuals in the general requirements, and the requirements for setting medium recovery and filtering devices in the structure and performance and hydraulic systems, both standards stipulate the requirements for hydraulic cylinders (including boosters) applicable to this hydraulic press, which should be satisfied in the selection and design of hydraulic cylinders for sheet fluid forming hydraulic press and pipe fluid forming hydraulic press.
1. Sheet fluid forming hydraulic press
In GB/T8541-2012, GB/T36484-2018, JB/T4174-2014 and JB/T12098-2014, there is no term "sheet fluid forming hydraulic press" and definition. JB/T12098-2014 stipulates the model and basic parameters, requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation and storage of sheet fluid forming hydraulic press, which is applicable to sheet fluid forming hydraulic press (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).
Note: In GB/T8541-2012 and GB/T36484-2018, there are terms "sheet hydraulic forming" and definitions.
(1) Model and basic parameters
1) Model: The model of the hydraulic press should be compiled in accordance with the provisions of GB/T28761.
2) Basic parameters: The basic parameters of the hydraulic press include nominal force, blank holding force, and maximum hydraulic forming pressure.
(2) Requirements
1) General requirements.
(1) The hydraulic press should indicate its basic parameters and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.
(2) The hydraulic forming process should comply with the provisions of GB/T28273-2012 "Classification of Hydraulic Forming Processes for Tubes and Sheets".
(3) A product nameplate should be fixed on an appropriate conspicuous position of each product, and the nameplate should meet the requirements specified in GB/T13306. The nameplate of the product should at least include the product name, model, basic parameters, manufacturing date, factory number, manufacturer's name and address, etc.
(4) The preparation of the product instruction manual should meet the requirements specified in GB/T9969, and its content should include the product name, model, main performance [nominal force and maximum stroke of the main hydraulic cylinder and blank holding cylinder, (highest or maximum) working pressure of the hydraulic system, maximum working pressure of the boosting cylinder, volume, distance from the movable beam to the worktable, lifting speed of the movable beam; effective dimensions of the worktable, power of the motor, etc.], standard number executed by the product, manufacturer's name and address, usage method, maintenance, and maintenance requirements, etc.
2) Appearance.
(1) The outer surface of the hydraulic press should not have protrusions, depressions, rough unevenness, and other damages not specified in the drawing.
(2) The edges of the joint surfaces of parts should be neat and uniform, and there should be no obvious misalignment. There should be no obvious gaps between the door, cover, and joint surfaces.
(3) The exposed welds should be trimmed to be flat and uniform.
(4) When the hydraulic pipelines, lubrication pipelines, and electrical lines are installed along the outline of the hydraulic press, they should be arranged neatly and should not contact with relatively moving parts.
(5) The countersunk head screws should not protrude from the surface of the part, and there should be no obvious eccentricity between the head and the countersunk hole. The fixed pin should slightly protrude from the surface of the part, and the end of the bolt should protrude from the nut, but the protruding part should not be too long or uneven.
575:
6) Painting: The painting of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of the technical documents. Adjusting bolts and nuts that need to be frequently tightened should not be painted. The non-machined metal external surfaces of the hydraulic press should be painted, or protected by other specified methods. The boundaries between different colored paints should be clear. After painting, the joints of the detachable assembly mating surfaces should be cut open, and the edges should not be torn during cutting.

7) Nameplates and trademarks should be fixed at conspicuous positions on the hydraulic press. The fixed positions of various nameplates should be correct, firm, straight, and neat, and should be clear and durable.

3) Assembly:
1) The assembly of the hydraulic press should comply with the assembly process specifications. Parts and their surfaces, as well as the lips of sealing rings, should not be damaged due to assembly. All assembled components (including externally purchased parts and outsourced parts) should meet quality requirements.

2) Important fixed mating surfaces should be tightly fitted. After pre-tightening, they should be inspected with a 0.05mm feeler gauge. The allowable depth of the feeler gauge insertion should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface. The total length of the parts where the feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. Important fixed mating surfaces include:
a. The fixed mating surface between the shoulder of the column and the working surface.
b. The fixed mating surface between the adjusting nut and locknut of the column and the upper beam and working table.
c. The fixed mating surface between the locknut of the hydraulic cylinder and the upper beam or frame beam.
d. The fixed mating surface between the shoulder of the piston (column) and the slider.
e. The fixed mating surface between the frame and the guide rail, and the fixed mating surface between the slider and the wear strip.
f. The fixed mating surface between the crossbeam and column of the combined frame frame.
g. The fixed mating surface between the working table plate and the working table.

3) For hydraulic cylinders with supporting ring sealing structures, the supporting ring should be properly tight and reliably locked. For moving parts (including pistons, movable crossbeams or sliders) that slide down quickly by their own weight, there should be no stagnation during rapid descent.

4) Before assembly, the pipe channels of the hydraulic system, lubrication system, cooling system, as well as the internal surfaces of the filling device and oil tank should be treated for rust removal and cleaning. The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the requirements of JB/T9954.

5) All pipes, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed or movable connected sealing points should be reliably connected and well sealed, without any oil leakage.

4) Accuracy: The accuracy of the hydraulic press should meet the requirements of GB/T9166.

5) Structure and Performance:
1) The hydraulic press consists of a frame, main hydraulic cylinder, pressing cylinder, ultra-high pressure generating device, ultra-high pressure liquid chamber, hydraulic control system, electrical system, and ultra-high pressure safety protection system.

2) The moving parts of the hydraulic press should operate correctly, smoothly, and reliably.

3) Within the specified stroke speed range, there should be no vibration, crawling, or stagnation.

4) During commutation and unloading, there should be no impact that affects normal operation.

5) The hydraulic press should have the function of controlling the forming liquid pressure (boosting cylinder pressure), main hydraulic cylinder pressure, pressing cylinder pressure, and stroke.

6) The hydraulic press should be equipped with a boosting cylinder. When the working pressure exceeds the set value, the equipment should be able to automatically unload and alarm.

7) The display accuracy of the system working pressure, the minimum setting value should not be greater than 0.2 MPa.

8) During no-load operation, load operation, and overload operation, there should be no leakage at the sealing points of various hydraulic components, pipes, etc. The oil temperature in the oil tank should not exceed 60°C.

9) The opening pressure of the safety valve (including the relief valve used with the safety valve) should generally not exceed 1.1 times the rated pressure. To prevent arbitrary pressure adjustment, protective measures should be taken.

Note: The forming medium in the liquid chamber adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion; a medium recovery and filtration device should be installed.

6) Pressure Resistance Performance:
1) The main hydraulic cylinder should be pressure tested at 1.25 times the maximum working pressure for 10 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or damage.

2) The pressing cylinder should be pressure tested at 1.25 times the maximum working pressure for 10 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or damage.

3) The boosting cylinder should undergo ultrasonic testing and be pressure tested at 1.1 times the maximum working pressure for 3 minutes without any leakage. The deformation amount of the cylinder barrel measured at the middle of the outer diameter should be less than the specified value of H8.

4) The ultra-high pressure liquid chamber and ultra-high pressure metal hard pipe should pass ultrasonic testing and be pressure tested at 1.1 times the maximum working pressure for 3 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or damage, and the pipes should not burst.

7) Hydraulic System:
1) The hydraulic system should have no oil leakage.

2) The oil temperature in the oil tank and the inlet temperature of the hydraulic pump should not exceed 60°C.

3) The forming medium in the liquid chamber adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion. A medium recovery and filtration device should be installed around the liquid chamber and on the working table.

8) Noise: The noise limit of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of GB2648.

9) Safety:
1) It should comply with the requirements of GB17120 and GB28241.

2) Safety protection doors and protective covers should be installed in the working area and around the mold of the hydraulic press.

3) The boosting cylinder should be equipped with a safety protection device.

⑦ The display accuracy of the system working pressure, the minimum setting value should not be greater than 0.2 MPa.
⑧ During no-load operation, load operation, and overload operation, there should be no leakage at the sealing parts of hydraulic components, pipelines, etc., and the oil temperature in the oil tank should not exceed 60°C.
⑨ The opening pressure of the safety valve (including the relief valve used with the safety valve) should generally not be greater than 1.1 times the rated pressure. To prevent arbitrary pressure adjustment, protective measures should be taken.
⑩ The liquid forming medium adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion; a medium recovery and filtration device should be installed.
6) Pressure Resistance Performance.
① The clamping cylinder should be kept under pressure for 10 minutes at a test pressure of 1.25 times the maximum working pressure, and there should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage.
② The axial feed cylinder should be kept under pressure for 10 minutes at a test pressure of 1.25 times the maximum working pressure, and there should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage.
③ The booster cylinder should undergo ultrasonic testing and be kept under pressure for 3 minutes at a test pressure of 1.1 times the maximum working pressure. There should be no leakage, and the deformation amount of the cylinder barrel should be less than the specified value of H8.
④ The ultra-high pressure metal hard pipe should pass ultrasonic testing and be kept under pressure for 3 minutes at a test pressure of 1.1 times the maximum working pressure. There should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage, and the pipeline should not burst.
7) Hydraulic System.
① The hydraulic system should have no oil leakage.
② The oil temperature in the oil tank and the inlet temperature of the hydraulic pump should not exceed 60°C.
③ The liquid forming medium adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion, and a medium recovery and filtration device is installed, which should operate reliably.
8) Noise. The noise limit of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB2648.
9) Safety.
① It should comply with the provisions of GB1712 and GB2824.
② Safety protection doors and protective covers should be installed around the working area and molds of the hydraulic press, and they should operate reliably.
③ A safety protection device should be installed on the booster cylinder.
④ The ultra-high pressure pipeline should have a protective sleeve.
⑤ The pressure relief device should operate reliably.
⑥ During the liquid forming process, if the workpiece being processed ruptures, the liquid filling system should immediately relieve pressure, and the hydraulic press should automatically stop and alarm.
⑦ The movable protective device should be interlocked with the electrical system to ensure that the hydraulic press can only perform clamping and forming actions after the protective door is closed.
⑧ Electrical safety should comply with the provisions of GB5226.1.
4.2.20 Precision Servo Straightening Hydraulic Press

It is mainly used for straightening shaft, tube, and rod workpieces. 2) The ram speed should meet the requirements of the technical documents and achieve functions such as fast approach, precise servo-controlled straightening, and return.
3) The hydraulic press control system adopts servo control technology and should have a position-holding function, with adjustable pressure-holding time.
4) The hydraulic press has the function of straightening shaft, tube, and rod workpieces.
5) The CNC system of the hydraulic press can control ram pressure, ram stroke, etc., and achieve precise straightening function through the control of multi-axis servo motion.
6) The ram stroke can be adjusted separately according to process requirements.
7) Wear-resistant measures should be taken for the sliding friction pairs of the hydraulic press, and there should be a reasonable hardness difference.
8) The operation of the hydraulic press should be stable and reliable. The hydraulic actuators should not have vibration, crawling, or jamming phenomena within the specified stroke and speed ranges, and there should be no impact phenomena affecting normal operation during commutation.

10) The hydraulic press can be equipped with interfaces for mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical devices for loading and unloading according to demand.

3) The machining requirements for the main parts shall conform to the provisions of the technical documents.

The lengths of screws mounted at the same location shall generally be the same. 4) The seals shall be free from damage. Before assembly, the seals and sealing surfaces shall be coated with grease. The direction of assembly shall be such that the working pressure of the medium will press the lip tightly. When assembling overlapping seals, the rings shall be pressed against each other, with the openings on the side of higher pressure.

5) The working environment temperature of the plate leveling machine (including pump station) is 0～40℃, with a maximum relative humidity of 60%. If there are special working environment requirements, they should be clearly stated in the technical agreement.

8) The product manual of the plate leveling machine should comprehensively provide product knowledge and methods of use that are compatible with the intended functions. It should include important information related to the safety and economical use of the plate leveling machine, as well as drawings and technical documents provided with the machine.

(2) Safety and Environmental Protection

1) The safety and hygiene design of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 5083.

2) The safety protection of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 17120 and JB 3915 (already repealed).

3) The hydraulic transmission and control system of the plate leveling machine should be equipped with overload safety protection devices.

4) The safety requirements for the electrical transmission and control system of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.

5) The plate leveling machine and its mechanical equipment and auxiliary devices should be equipped with safety interlock control and stroke limit protection devices.

6) Emergency stop buttons should be installed at multiple locations such as the control panel in the control room, control system, and pump station of the plate leveling machine.

7) The noise limit value of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 2948.

8) The measurement methods for noise sound pressure level and sound pressure power level of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 23281 and GB/T 23282.

9) Discarded or leaked working medium of the plate leveling machine should be entrusted to a qualified professional company for recycling and treatment, or processed according to the requirements of the local environmental protection department. (4) Technical requirements for main components
1) The upper beam, lower beam and column of combined frame are generally welded structures made of carbon structural steel plates specified in JB/T 7000, and the welds shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.3. Stress relief heat treatment shall be performed after welding, and secondary heat treatment shall be performed after rough machining. Appropriate materials and ReL values shall be selected according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor shall be 2-2.5 (take the upper limit for small hydraulic presses and the lower limit for large hydraulic presses). The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material (standard).
2) The tie rods in the combined frame are generally made of carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T 6999, and shall be subjected to quenching and tempering heat treatment. Appropriate materials and ReL values shall be selected according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor shall be 2.5-3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard. The inspection items and sampling quantity shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8-2007 for the acceptance grouping level of forgings, Group V.
3) The main cylinder and return stroke cylinder are generally made of integral carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T 6397, or can also be manufactured by welding method of split forgings. The forgings shall be subjected to quenching and tempering treatment. Appropriate materials and ReL values shall be selected according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor shall be greater than or equal to 3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard. The inspection items and sampling quantity shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8-2007 for the acceptance grouping level of forgings, Group V. The tangential mechanical properties ReL, Rm, A, Z, and Ak shall be inspected piece by piece.
4) The plunger of the working cylinder is generally made of integral carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T 6397, or can also be manufactured by welding method of split forgings, and shall be subjected to corresponding heat treatment. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard. The surface of the plunger shall be hardened, and the hardness of the working surface shall not be lower than 48 HRC, and the thickness of the hardened layer shall be greater than 3 mm.
5) The hardness of the horizontal and side guide plate surface fixed on the upper beam shall not be lower than 269 HBW.
6) The hardness of the upper guide plate surface for supporting the roller of the workbench moving trolley fixed on the upper beam shall not be lower than 269 HBW.
(5) Forgings, castings, and welded parts
1) The general technical conditions for non-ferrous metal castings of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.5.
2) The general technical conditions for forgings of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8.
3) The general technical conditions for welded parts of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.3.
4) The general technical conditions for flame-cut parts in the product manufacturing process shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.2.
5) The quality grade of fully penetrated welds in welded parts of products is BK, BS grade, and ultrasonic testing shall be carried out according to GB/T 11345.
6) The parts and grades for ultrasonic testing of the upper beam, lower beam and column after rough machining shall be clearly marked on the drawing.
