2. Technical Requirements (Related to Hydraulic Cylinder)

(1) General Requirements

1) The drawings and technical documents of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of J B/T 12381.2—2015 standard, and should be approved through the prescribed procedures before production.

2) The product shape and layout of the hydraulic press should consider the requirements of aesthetic design and ergonomics, and be convenient for use, maintenance, assembly, and transportation.

3) The hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of J B/T 38118.

4) The hydraulic press should be able to work normally under the following environmental conditions:
① The ambient air temperature should comply with the provisions of 4.4.3 in G B 52226.1—2008 (replaced by G B/T 52226.1—2019).
② The humidity should comply with the provisions of 4.4.4 in G B 52226.1—2008 (replaced by G B/T 52226.1—2019).
③ Altitude below 1000 m.

(2) Basic Parameters

The basic parameters of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of J B/T 12381.1 (see Table 4-69) or meet the contractual agreement.

(3) Structure, Performance, and Function

1) The hydraulic press should have sufficient strength and stiffness.

2) The hydraulic press should have the ability to work continuously according to the predetermined instructions.

3) The hydraulic press should have the function of controlling the forming liquid pressure of the product, the working pressure of the horizontal cylinder, and the displacement of the piston of the horizontal cylinder.

4) The hydraulic press should be equipped with an internal exhaust system, and the exhaust time can be controlled.

5) The hydraulic press should be able to output the forming liquid pressure curve of the product, the working pressure input and output curve of the horizontal cylinder.

6) For a hydraulic press equipped with a booster cylinder, when the working pressure exceeds the set (maximum) value, it should be able to automatically unload and give an alarm.

7) The display accuracy and minimum setting amount of the working pressure of the (hydraulic) system and the working pressure of the horizontal cylinder should both be ≤0.2 MPa.

8) The display accuracy and minimum setting amount of the displacement of each piston of the horizontal cylinder should both be ≤0.02 mm.

(4) Safety and Protection

1) The safety protection of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of G B 17120 and G B 28241.

2) Fixed protective doors should be installed on the left and right sides of the worktable. Movable protective doors should be used on the front and rear sides, and should be interlocked and controlled by the electrical system to ensure that the hydraulic press can enter the mold closing and forming actions only when the protective doors are closed.

3) A slide block locking device should be used when changing or repairing the mold.

4) The oil tank should be equipped with a liquid level alarm device.

5) The hydraulic system should have overload protection function, and be equipped with a hydraulic safety valve to ensure that the hydraulic press will not work under overload conditions.

(5) Noise

The sound of the hydraulic press during operation should be normal, and its noise limit should comply with the provisions of G B 26484.

(6) Precision

The precision of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of J B/T 12381.3.

(7) Marking

1) The hydraulic press should have nameplates and various signs or marks for lubrication, safety, etc. The type, size, material, and technical requirements of the signs should comply with the provisions of G B/T 13306. The symbolic signs on the nameplates should comply with the provisions of J B/T 3240.

2) The signs should be fixed properly in obvious parts of the hydraulic press, and ensure clarity.

3) The nameplate of the hydraulic press should include at least the following contents:
① The name and address of the manufacturing enterprise.
② The model and basic parameters of the product.

3. Test methods
(1) Load operation test
1) The load operation test should be conducted after the empty operation test is qualified, and the nominal force, required power, temperature change, noise, and other items should be detected.
2) Adjust the liquid working pressure. Gradually increase the input pressure of the upper cylinder, horizontal cylinder, and booster cylinder to 12 MPa, 18 MPa, and 25 MPa respectively. Maintain it for 3 seconds at each pressure level and repeat it 3 times. The pressure repetition accuracy of the upper cylinder is ±1.5 MPa, and that of the horizontal cylinder is ±0.8 MPa. The action should be accurate and reliable.
3) Under the system pressure of 25 MPa, conduct a working cycle to check whether the signal elements are reliable and whether the hydraulic and electrical systems are sensitive and reliable.
4) During load operation, there should be no leakage at the sealing parts of various hydraulic components and pipes, and the oil temperature of the oil tank should not exceed 60°C.
5) During load operation, the current of the motor should comply with the specified requirements.
6) The noise of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB2648.
7) After the above detections are qualified, conduct a 4-hour continuous load operation detection in semi-automatic mode.
(2) Overload test
The overload test should be combined with the test of the allowable setting value of the safety valve. The overload test of the booster cylinder only tests the primary pressure. The overload test pressure is 27.5 MPa. The test should be conducted for at least 3 times, each time lasting 3 seconds. The parts of the hydraulic press should not have any damage or permanent deformation, and the hydraulic system should not have leakage or other abnormal phenomena.
4. Accuracy
The inspection requirements and accuracy inspection of the hydraulic press are shown in JB/T12381.3-2015.
Among them, the inspection of "the parallelism of the vertical direction of the movement trajectory of the piston of the horizontal cylinder to the plane of the worktable (backing plate)" and "the parallelism of the horizontal direction of the movement trajectory of the piston of the horizontal cylinder" has reference value for the detection of the runout of the hydraulic cylinder.

It can control pressure, stroke, holding pressure, and other parameters.

6) The requirements for plungers and piston rods should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
(8) Mechanical Processing
1) The brand and mechanical properties of the materials of various processed parts of the hydraulic press should meet the functional requirements of the hydraulic press and comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards.
2) The processing requirements for main parts should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
3) The processed surfaces should not have burrs, spots, and other mechanical damages, and should not have defects that reduce the use quality and worsen the appearance of the hydraulic press. Unless otherwise specified, sharp edges should be blunted.

5) The contact of the guide rail working surfaces should be uniform. The cumulative value of the contact area should not be less than 80% along the full length of the guide rail and not less than 70% along the width direction of the guide rail.

The lengths of screws in the same part should generally be the same. The fastened screws, bolts, and nuts should not have looseness, and screws affecting accuracy should not have looseness.

3) During the testing process, components and parts that affect the performance and accuracy of the hydraulic press should not be adjusted. If adjustment is necessary, relevant items should be re-examined.
4) The test should be conducted after the hydraulic press is fully assembled. Except for parts that need to be disassembled during testing as specified in the standard or technical document, other parts should not be disassembled.

The overload test should generally not exceed 1.1 times the rated pressure, and the test should be no less than 3 times. 4.2.24 High-speed Thin Plate Stamping and Drawing Hydraulic Press
High-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic press refers to a frame-type thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic press with a rapid downward speed and return speed of the slider not less than 300 m/s, and a pressing speed not less than 15-45 mm/s (15 mm/s refers to the pressing speed at 100% nominal force, and 40 mm/s refers to the pressing speed at not less than 30% nominal force). JB/T12994.1-2017 stipulates the types and basic parameters of high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses; JB/T12994.2-2017 stipulates the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, storage, and warranty for high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses; JB/T12994.3-2017 stipulates the accuracy inspection of high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses, applicable to high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses.
High-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic press is mainly used for bending, punching, blanking, drawing, shaping, forming, and other processes of various metal thin plate parts.

(1) General Requirements
1) The drawings and technical documents of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of JB/T12994.2-2017 standard and should be approved according to the prescribed procedures before production can be started.

3) The hydraulic press should be easy to use, maintain, assemble, disassemble, and transport.
4) The hydraulic press should be able to work normally under the following environmental conditions:
① The ambient temperature is 5 ~ 40 ℃. For extremely hot environments (such as tropical climate, steel mills) and cold environments, additional requirements must be proposed.
② When the maximum temperature is 40 ℃, the relative humidity should not exceed 50%; At lower temperatures, higher relative humidity is allowed, such as 90% relative humidity at 20 ℃.

5) Under correct use and normal maintenance conditions, the working time from the beginning of use to the first overhaul of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T1829.
(2) Type and basic parameters
The type and basic parameters of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T1299.1-2017.
(3) Performance, structure and function
1) The hydraulic press should have sufficient rigidity. Under the maximum load working condition test, the hydraulic press should be able to work normally.
2) The speed of the slider should comply with the provisions of JB/T1299.1-2017 and the requirements of technical documents, and realize the functions of fast descent, pressing, and return.
3) The hydraulic press should have a pressure holding function, and the pressure holding time should be adjustable.
4) The hydraulic press has functions such as stamping, stretching, blanking, shaping, and forming.
5) The numerical control system of the hydraulic press should be able to control the slider pressure, hydraulic pad force, slider stroke, hydraulic pad stroke, etc., and can realize synchronous or independent actions.
6) The pressure and stroke of the slider and hydraulic pad can be adjusted separately according to process requirements.
7) The sliding friction pairs of the hydraulic press should take wear-resistant measures and have a reasonable hardness difference.
8) The operation of the hydraulic press should be stable and reliable. The hydraulic actuators should not have vibration, crawling, and stagnation phenomena within the specified stroke and speed range, and should not have impact phenomena that affect normal operation when reversing.
9) When the system pressure is overloaded, the oil temperature is exceeded, or the oil level is below the lower limit, the hydraulic press should automatically shut down and alarm.
10) The hydraulic press can be equipped with a buffer device. The buffer device should effectively absorb the energy generated during the blanking process. The blanking buffer process should be stable and low-noise, and its buffer action point can be adjusted within the specified range.
11) The hydraulic press can be configured with mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical interfaces for loading and unloading devices according to needs.
12) The coordinated and reliable connection action of the hydraulic press and its supporting auxiliary devices.
(4) Safety and protection
1) When the hydraulic press is manufactured, installed, transported, and used according to regulations, it should not pose a danger to personnel, and should comply with the provisions of GB2824-1 and GB17120.
2) The safety requirements for electrical transmission and control of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB5226.1.
(5) Noise
The noise value of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB26484.
(6) Accuracy
The geometric accuracy and working accuracy of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T1299.4-2017.
(7) Random accessories, tools and technical documents
1) When the hydraulic press leaves the factory, it should ensure completeness and be equipped with accessories for normal use of the equipment, as well as the required special tools. The supply of special accessories is determined by both the supplier and the demander.
2) The manufacturer should ensure the quality of purchased parts (including hydraulic, electrical, pneumatic, and cooling parts) used in the hydraulic press, and should comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards. When leaving the factory, the purchased parts should be tested for empty operation with the hydraulic press.
3) Random technical documents should include product instruction manuals, product qualification certificates, packing lists, product installation and maintenance drawings, and drawings of wearing parts. The product instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T9969, and its content should include requirements for installation, transportation, storage, use, maintenance, and safety and hygiene.
4) The spare parts or wearing parts provided with the hydraulic press should have interchangeability. Spare parts and special accessories are not included, and users can negotiate with the manufacturer. Spare parts can be supplied randomly or separately, and the supply content shall be executed according to the order contract.
(8) Nameplates and signs
1) The hydraulic press should have nameplates and various signs or signs for lubrication, safety, etc. The type, size, material, and technical requirements of the nameplate should comply with the provisions of GB/T13306.
2) The nameplate should be fixed properly in a conspicuous position on the hydraulic press and ensure clarity.
3) The nameplate of the hydraulic press should include at least the following contents:
① The name and address of the manufacturing enterprise.
② The model and basic parameters of the product.
③ The year of leaving the factory and the serial number.
(9) Castings, forgings, and welded parts
1) Castings and forgings for important parts used in the manufacture of hydraulic presses should have qualification certificates.
2) The gray cast iron parts of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T5775, and the cast steel parts and non-ferrous metal castings should comply with the provisions of the technical documents. Important castings should be subjected to heat treatment or other methods to eliminate internal stress to reduce stress.

4) The machining accuracy and surface roughness of guide rail surfaces should ensure meeting the accuracy requirements and technical requirements of the hydraulic press.

5) The contact of guide rail working surfaces should be uniform. The cumulative contact area on the full length of the guide rail should not be less than 80%, and on the width of the guide rail should not be less than 70%.

Fastened screws, bolts, and nuts should not have looseness, and the tightening force of screws affecting accuracy should be consistent.

3) Seals should not have damage. Before assembly, seals and sealing surfaces should be coated with grease. The assembly direction should make the working pressure of the medium press the lip tightly. 4.2.25 CNC Hydraulic Punching and Drilling Composite Machine
There are no terms and definitions of "CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machine" in GB/T8541—2012, GB/T3648—2018, JB/T4174—2014, and JB/T3363—2017. In JB/T3363—2017, technical requirements, accuracy, test methods, inspection rules, and signs, packaging, and storage and transportation for the manufacturing and acceptance of CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machines are specified. It is applicable to CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machines for punching, drilling, and marking on various flat plate parts, and also to CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machines for punching and marking only (hereinafter referred to as composite machines).

1. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements
1) The composite machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T3363—2017 standard and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.
2) The materials used for manufacturing the composite machine should meet the design requirements, and the grade and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the provisions of the corresponding standards.
3) The completeness of the composite machine should be ensured, including electrical equipment, hydraulic and pneumatic components, special tools, and anchor bolts.

(2) Safety Protection
1) The safety of the composite machine should be ensured, and the possibility of danger should be avoided and reduced as much as possible through design.
2) Safety devices or safety measures should be installed on parts of the composite machine that may endanger personal safety or cause equipment damage. Its safety protection should comply with the relevant provisions of GB1720.
3) The actions of various mechanisms of the composite machine should be reliably interlocked. Under the condition of correct input parameters, no action interference or component damage should occur when there is an operation or programming error.
4) For hydraulic circuits containing accumulators, the pressure of the accumulator should be automatically relieved when the system is shut down, or the circuit should be safely isolated from the accumulator. At the same time, a warning sign should be set in a prominent position, stating "Attention - the device must be depressurized before the start of maintenance work!".
5) Warning signs with the following contents should be set on the accumulator, and should be explained in the manual:
  ① Caution - pressure vessel.
  ② Only nitrogen is allowed.
  ③ Gas pressure is 3～3.2 MPa.
6) The accumulator should be designed and manufactured by a design and production unit approved by the national designated safety supervision agency, and should have a qualification certificate.
7) The inflation and installation of the accumulator should comply with the provisions of the manufacturer. The installation position of the accumulator should make maintenance easily accessible. The accumulator and its pressure-bearing components should be firmly fixed and safe and reliable.

(3) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts
1) The welding quality of welded parts of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T8609.
2) Forgings should not have defects such as delamination, folding, cracks, forging defects, scars, and slag inclusions.
3) Castings should not have casting defects such as sand holes, air holes, shrinkage cavities, cold shuts, slag inclusions, and cracks that affect working performance and appearance.
4) Defects that do not affect safe use, service life, and appearance are allowed to be repaired according to the relevant provisions under the condition of ensuring quality.
5) Important welded metal components and castings, forgings, such as the body, worktable, base, hydraulic cylinder barrel, drilling power head box, etc., should be subjected to stress relief treatment. Parts treated by artificial aging should ensure the aging effect.
6) Important castings, forgings, and welded parts should be subjected to flaw detection inspection, and the results should comply with the provisions of the relevant standards and technical documents.

(4) Part Processing
1) The machined surface of parts should not have burrs and defects that reduce the use quality and worsen the appearance of the composite machine, such as bumps, scratches, and rust.
2) Sharp edges and corners on machined parts should be blunted if not specified in the drawing.
3) The scraping surface of parts should not have traces of previous machining, and the scraping points on the entire scraping surface should be uniform.

(5) Electrical System
The electrical system of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB5226.1.

(6) Numerical Control System
1) The environmental adaptability, safety, power supply adaptability, electromagnetic compatibility, and manufacturing quality of the numerical control system of the composite machine should comply with the relevant provisions of JB/T8832 (already obsolete).
2) The numerical control system should meet the use requirements of the composite machine, and should have automatic and manual operation functions, program editing functions, self-diagnosis functions, and alarm display functions.
3) The determination of positioning accuracy and repeated positioning accuracy of numerical control axes should comply with the provisions of GB/T17421.2.

(7) Hydraulic, Pneumatic, Cooling, and Lubrication Systems
1) The hydraulic system of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T3766.
2) The oil tank, hydraulic cylinder, valve body, pipelines, etc. of the hydraulic system should be strictly cleaned, and there should be no iron filings and dirt inside. The burrs should be completely removed. All working media entering the oil tank and hydraulic system of the composite machine should ensure cleanliness, and the grade of working oil should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
3) The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T9954.

1) During sub-assembly and final assembly, parts such as gaskets and sleeves not specified in the drawings should not be installed.

2) The important fixed joint surfaces of the composite machine should be tightly fitted. A feeler gauge of 0.04 mm should only be allowed to be inserted locally, with an insertion depth not exceeding 20 mm, and the total length of the insertable part should not exceed 10% of the measurable length. The important fixed joint surfaces include: the joint surfaces between guide rails and sliders and their mating parts, the joint surfaces between screw rod supports and nut seats and their mating parts, the joint surface between punch guide seat and bed, the joint surface between die holder and bed, the joint surface between punch hydraulic cylinder and bed, and the mounting surface of the spindle box and its mating parts.

3) The top heights of the universal balls on the worktable should be consistent. The imaginary plane formed by the tops of the universal balls and the upper plane of the die should be in the same plane, with a maximum height difference not greater than 0.60 mm, and only the upper plane of the die is allowed to be lower.

4) The positioning surfaces of the two pairs of jaw plates should be in the same plane, with a maximum height difference not greater than 0.10 mm.

5) The upper plane of the lower jaw of the two pairs of jaw plates should be lower than the imaginary plane formed by the tops of the universal balls, with a height difference of 0.30 to 0.50 mm.

6) When the punch is in the lower position, the depth of the punch entering the die should be no less than 4 mm.

7) After the punch enters the die, the clearance around it should be uniform. The difference between the maximum clearance and minimum clearance should not be greater than 0.20 mm.

8) When the drill bit is in the lower position and enters the pad die's round hole, the clearance around it should be uniform. The difference between the maximum clearance and minimum clearance should not be greater than 1.0 mm.

9) The ball screw pair installed on each moving axis should be run multiple times after assembly, and the backlash should not be greater than 0.05 mm.

10) The drag chain should be fixed properly. The hoses and cables in the drag chain should be arranged neatly without tangling or crossing. When the moving parts move, the drag chain should not shift or deform.

11) The bolts and screws should be tightened, and the anti-loosening washers should be effective. Bolts and nuts of the same specification at the same location should have consistent shapes and surface treatments. Screws inserted into countersunk holes should not protrude from the surface of the parts.

12) Each travel switch should be installed firmly, in the correct position, and with an appropriate sensing distance.

(9) Noise

When the composite machine is running, there should be no abnormal vibration, irregular impact sounds, or sharp screams. The equivalent continuous sound pressure level during idling should not be greater than 85 dB(A). The measurement method should comply with the provisions of GB/T23281.

(10) Appearance

1) The appearance surface of the composite machine should not have protrusions, depressions, roughness, or other damages not specified in the drawings. The exposed machined surfaces should not have knocks, scratches, or rust.

2) The exposed welds should be in the form of smooth or uniform scaly wave patterns. Splatter on the surface should be cleaned up and ground smooth.

3) Non-machined surfaces should be filled with putty and polished smooth. The paint color should be uniform, without defects such as peeling, bubbles, flow marks, or missing spray. The dividing line between different paint colors should be clear.

4) Surfaces of bolts, nuts, oil cups, non-metallic pipes, and other surfaces that do not need to be painted should not have paint attached.

5) The exposed parts of various pipe lines should be arranged compactly, neatly, and fixed firmly.

6) The various nameplates on the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T13306, with correct motion directions, clear and easy-to-understand text descriptions, conspicuous and appropriate installation positions, and neat and beautiful fixing. The stamped text should be clear and legible.

7) The protective layer of electroplated, blued, or blackened parts on the composite machine should be intact, without defects such as discoloration, cracking, peeling, or rust.

8) The surface of the protective cover of the composite machine should be flat and should not warp or dent.

Note: The expression "splatter" is not found in JB/T8609—2014.

(11) Random technical documents and accessories

1) The random accessories, tools, and spare parts should be complete, and the wearing parts of the composite machine should be easy to replace.

2) The random technical documents of the composite machine should include the product instruction manual, product quality certificate, and packing list. The compilation of the random technical documents should comply with the relevant provisions of GB/T23571. The instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T9969.

2. Other

The operation test, accuracy, inspection rules and marks, packaging, storage, and transportation of the composite machine are specified in GB/T33639—2017.

Article 10: Mechanical Processing
1) The grade and mechanical properties of the materials for the various machined parts of the hydraulic press for end forming should satisfy the functions of the hydraulic press for end forming and conform to the stipulations in the technical documentation.
2) The processing requirements for the main parts should conform to the stipulations in the technical documentation.
3) The processed surfaces should not have burrs, spots, or other mechanical damage, and should not have defects that reduce the quality of use of the hydraulic press for end forming or worsen its appearance. Except for special stipulations, sharp edges should be blunted.
4) The processing precision and surface roughness of the guide rail surfaces should ensure that the precision requirements and technical requirements of the hydraulic press for end forming are met.
5) The contact of the working surfaces of the guide rails should be uniform, and the cumulative value of the contact area should not be less than 80% in the full length of the guide rails and not less than 70% in the width of the guide rails.

Article 11: Assembly
1) The hydraulic press for end forming should be assembled according to the technical documentation and drawings, and parts, their surfaces, and the lips of the sealing rings should not be damaged due to assembly. After assembly, the actions of each mechanism should be sensitive, accurate, and reliable.
2) After assembly, the heads of bolts and screws and the end faces of nuts should have uniform contact with the plane of the parts being fastened, and should not be tilted or have gaps. The lengths of screws assembled at the same part should generally be consistent. Fastened screws, bolts, and nuts should not have looseness, and the fastening force of screws affecting precision should be consistent.
3) Sealing parts should not have damage, and the sealing parts and sealing surfaces should be coated with lubricating grease before assembly. The direction of assembly should make the working pressure of the medium tightly press the lips. When assembling overlapping sealing rings, the rings should be pressed against each other, and the opening direction should be placed on the side with higher pressure.
4) After the assembly of moving and rotating parts, the movement should be smooth, flexible, light, and free of jamming. The rolling guide rail surface and all rolling bodies should have uniform contact, and the movement should be light, flexible, and free of jamming.
5) The important joint surfaces, after fastening, should be tightly fitted, and the gaps should conform to the stipulations in Table 4-85. The allowable depth of insertion of a feeler gauge should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface, and the cumulative length of the parts where a feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. The important joint surfaces are:
① The joint surface between the large nut and the crossbeam (upper crossbeam, lower crossbeam).
② The joint surface between the upper crossbeam, lower crossbeam, and the frame (referring to the columns in the frame type).
③ The joint surface between the flange shoulder of the hydraulic cylinder and the crossbeam.
④ The joint surface between the end faces of the piston rod and plunger and the slider.
⑤ The joint surface between the worktable and the lower crossbeam.

If a large hydraulic press for end forming cannot be assembled as a whole in the manufacturing plant due to manufacturing conditions, through negotiation between the manufacturing plant and the user, the manufacturing plant can assemble it as a whole at the user's site and execute it according to the agreement or contract between both parties.

Article 12: Electrical Equipment
1) The electrical equipment of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the stipulations of GB 226.1.
2) When a programmable controller or computer control is used, it should conform to the stipulations of the current relevant standards.

Article 13: Hydraulic, Pneumatic, Lubricating, and Cooling Systems
1) The hydraulic system of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the requirements of GB/T3766.
2) The purchased and self-made hydraulic components should conform to the stipulations of GB/T7935.
3) The cast hydraulic cylinder and the rough-processed forged hydraulic cylinder of the hydraulic press for end forming should generally undergo a pressure test, with the test pressure being 1.25 times the working pressure, and the holding time should not be less than 10 min. After the test, the hydraulic cylinder should not leak and should have no permanent deformation. If the overall forged cylinder and the forged-structured hydraulic cylinder have process guarantees such as non-destructive testing, the intermediate pressure test may not be conducted.
4) During the operation of the hydraulic press for end forming, the oil temperature at the oil inlet of the oil tank of the hydraulic system should generally not exceed 60℃.
5) A filter device should be installed in the hydraulic system.
6) The oil tank must undergo a kerosene leakage test; an air filter should be installed in the open oil tank.
7) The pipe channels of the hydraulic and cooling systems and the inner surfaces of the oil tank should be thoroughly treated for rust prevention and decontamination before assembly.
8) The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should conform to the stipulations of JB/T9954.
9) The pneumatic system of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the stipulations of GB/T7932, and the installation slope of the pipeline on the side for discharging condensed water should not be less than 1:500.
10) The lubricating system of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the stipulations of GB/T6576.
11) The important friction parts of the hydraulic press for end forming should generally adopt a centralized lubricating system. Only when a centralized lubricating system cannot be used can a decentralized lubricating device be adopted.
12) The cooling system should meet the temperature and temperature rise requirements of the hydraulic press for end forming.
13) The lubricating and cooling systems should continuously or periodically deliver lubricants and coolants to the specified parts as needed.

4.2.29 Mobile Rotary Head Frame Hydraulic Press
The mobile rotary head frame hydraulic press is a frame hydraulic press in which the head and the movable worktable can move left and right simultaneously or independently, and the head and the rotary worktable can rotate 360° simultaneously or independently. JB/T12996.1—2017 stipulates the types and basic parameters of mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses with nominal forces ranging from 6000 to 200000 kN; JB/T12996.2—2017 stipulates the technical requirements, inspection rules, test methods, accuracy inspection, marking, packaging and random documents for mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses; JB/T12996.3—2017 stipulates the accuracy inspection items, tolerances and inspection methods for mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses, which are applicable to assembled mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses whose head accuracy cannot be adjusted, and whose head and movable worktable can move, and whose head and rotary worktable can rotate (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).

(1) Types
The basic type of the hydraulic press is a combined frame structure (see Figure 1 in JB/T12996.1—2017).

4.2.3.0  Steam Curing Brick Automatic Hydraulic Press
In GB/T36484-2018, JB/T4174-2014, and JC/T2034-2010, there is no term and definition of "steam curing brick automatic hydraulic press". JC/T2034-2010 stipulates the terms and definitions, classification, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules and marks, packaging, transportation, and storage of steam curing brick automatic hydraulic presses, and is applicable to automatic hydraulic presses (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic presses) that are formed by pressure using coal ash, sand, and other materials as the main raw materials.
1. Classification, Model, and Basic Parameters
(1) Type
1) Classification by frame structure.
Hydraulic presses are classified into beam-column hydraulic presses and integral welded hydraulic presses according to the characteristics of their frame structure.
① Beam-column hydraulic press. The frame of the beam-column hydraulic press is composed of an upper crossbeam, a lower crossbeam, and columns connected by threads.
② Integral welded hydraulic press. The frame of the integral welded hydraulic press is formed by integral welding.
2) Classification by pressing characteristics.
Hydraulic presses are classified into upper pressing hydraulic presses, lower pressing hydraulic presses, and bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic presses according to their pressing characteristics.
① Upper pressing hydraulic press. The main hydraulic cylinder is installed on the upper crossbeam, and the upper mold core is driven to move downward to realize the pressing action.
② Lower pressing hydraulic press. The main hydraulic cylinder is installed on the lower crossbeam, and the lower mold core is driven to move upward to realize the pressing action.
③ Bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic press.
a. Upper and lower hydraulic cylinders bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic press. The upper and lower crossbeams are respectively equipped with main hydraulic cylinders, driving the upper and lower mold cores to move towards each other to realize bidirectional pressing.
b. Lower movable crossbeam floating bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic press. Bidirectional pressing is realized by utilizing the speed difference between the main hydraulic cylinder and the frame floating hydraulic cylinder.
(2) Model
The model representation method and model writing method are as specified in JC/T2034-2010.
(3) Basic Parameters
The basic parameters of the hydraulic press are shown in Table 4-90.

(1) Basic Requirements
1) The hydraulic press shall comply with the requirements of the JC/T2034-2010 standard and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved through the prescribed procedures.

4.2.31 Automatic Hydraulic Press for Refractory Brick
The terms and definitions of "automatic hydraulic press for refractory brick" are not provided in GB/T 3684—2018, JB/T 4174—2014, and JC/T 2178—2013. The terms and definitions, types, models and basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, as well as marks, packaging, transportation and storage of automatic hydraulic press for refractory brick are specified in JC/T 2178—2013, applicable to automatic hydraulic press for refractory brick (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).
Note: The definition of the term "hydraulic press for refractory brick" is given in GB/T 3684—2018 and JB/T 4174—2014, i.e. hydraulic press for pressing refractory brick.
1. Type, Model and Basic Parameters
(1) Type
Hydraulic press is classified into two types based on its pressing method: hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of upper and lower hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of main hydraulic cylinder and floating mold frame.
1) Hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of upper and lower hydraulic cylinders. Main hydraulic cylinders are installed on the upper and lower beams respectively to drive the upper and lower mold cores to move towards each other, thus realizing double-acting pressing, represented by S.
2) Hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of main hydraulic cylinder and floating mold frame. Double-acting pressing is realized by the upper main hydraulic cylinder or lower main hydraulic cylinder and mold frame to drive the hydraulic cylinder at different running speeds, represented by C.

4.2.3.2 Automatic Hydraulic Press for Ceramic Tiles
The automatic hydraulic press for ceramic tiles is a forming machine that shapes the blank material into green bricks under full automatic control through hydraulic pressure. JC/T 9010—2013 specifies the terms and definitions, classifications, models and basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, and marking, packaging, transportation, and storage for the automatic hydraulic press for ceramic tiles (hereinafter referred to as the brick press). 4.2.23 Hydraulic Oil Press
Hydraulic oil press is a pressing equipment that uses Pascal's law to squeeze out grease from oil materials under pressure in the cake ring. Provisions for relevant terms and definitions, working principles, classification, models and basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, signs, packaging, transportation and storage requirements of hydraulic oil press are specified in GB/T 2573-2010, applicable to intermittent hydraulic oil presses with a total pressure not exceeding 200 kN.
1. Working Principle
Hydraulic oil press uses Pascal's mechanical principle, using liquid as the medium for pressure transmission to generate working pressure, so that oil materials are squeezed out of grease under pressure in the cake ring. It is a closed-loop system composed of two major parts: hydraulic system and oil press body.
2. Classification
1) According to different piston plate movement modes:
① Vertical hydraulic oil press. Its piston plate moves vertically.
② Horizontal hydraulic oil press. Its piston plate moves horizontally.
2) According to different power sources:
① Manual pressurization hydraulic oil press.
② Electric pressurization hydraulic oil press.
3. Models and Basic Parameters
(1) Model Compilation Method
The model compilation method of hydraulic oil press shall comply with Appendix A of GB/T 2573-2010.
(2) Basic Parameter Items
The basic parameter items of hydraulic oil press include model specifications, production capacity, motor power, external dimensions, overall mass, working pressure, total pressure, service life and working time before first failure of key parts (such as piston plate and cake ring), etc. They should be clearly marked in technical documents such as instruction manuals.
4. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements
1) Hydraulic oil press shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 2573-2010 standard, and be manufactured according to drawings and technical documents approved through prescribed procedures.
2) Raw materials, purchased parts, outsourced parts, etc. shall be accompanied by qualification certificates, and can only be used after passing acceptance.
3) Plate-shaped steel structural parts shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 24857.
4) Castings shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 24856.
5) Welded parts shall comply with the provisions of LS/T 3051.6.
6) The quality of main parts shall comply with the provisions of LS/T 3501.2.
7) Assembly shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 24855.
8) Product painting shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 25218.
9) The selection of materials and mechanical processing quality of the hydraulic system shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766.
(2) Mechanical Performance
1) Operation should be normal and stable, without abnormal vibration or noise.
2) Various adjustment, operation, display and other devices must be complete, sensitive, accurate and reliable.
3) During normal operation, the no-load noise should not exceed 85 dB(A).
4) The verticality of the piston rod or plunger of the main hydraulic cylinder to the pressure-bearing beam should be less than or equal to 1.5/1000 throughout the entire stroke.
5) The installation of hydraulic components and pipelines should prevent sealing parts from being scratched, ensuring no external leakage. Exposed pipelines should be arranged neatly and firmly.
6) The unit pressure of the oil press on the cake surface should not be less than 9 MPa.
7) During the pressure test, the hydraulic system should have no external leakage; the pressure drop after stabilization for 15 minutes should be less than 4% of the working pressure.
(3) Safety Requirements
1) Safety warning signs should comply with the provisions of GB Z1158-2003 "Occupational Disease Hazard Warning Signs in Workplaces".
2) The electrical safety of the equipment should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1, and its overload protection and grounding protection should have interlocking devices.
3) The hydraulic system should have an overload protection device.

4.2.35 Hydraulic Press for Free Forging with Direct Drive Pump and Tilted Double-Column

The hydraulic press for free forging is a hydraulic press that uses high-pressure liquid transmission and is used for free forging processing. In the first product standard for free forging hydraulic presses in China, JB/T1222.9-2015, the types and technical parameters, technical conditions, test methods, inspection and acceptance rules, markings, packaging, transportation, and storage of hydraulic presses for free forging with direct drive pump and tilted double-column are specified. It is applicable to hydraulic presses for free forging with direct drive pump and tilted double-column that use mineral oil-based hydraulic oil as the working medium (hereinafter referred to as double-column forging hydraulic press).

1. Types and Technical Parameters

(1) Types

There are two basic types of frames for double-column forging hydraulic press: pre-stressed combined frame with tilted double-column and integral frame with tilted double-column. The transmission types of the main (side) cylinder are upper transmission and lower transmission. When applicable, a tilted double-column pre-stressed combined frame with lower transmission type can also be used, as well as a "cylinder-moving" type of tilted double-column frame.

The main (side) cylinder is generally a plunger type. The connection between it and the movable crossbeam or the integral frame should preferably adopt a double-ball hinge connecting rod shaft structure. The guiding method of the movable crossbeam or the integral frame adopts an adjustable clearance plane guiding structure.

Note: In JB/T 1222.9-2015, "double-column combined frame" and "double-column integral frame" are defined.

1) Tilted double-column pre-stressed combined frame with upper transmission forging hydraulic press (type shown in Figure 1a of JB/T 1222.9-2015).

2) Tilted double-column integral frame with lower transmission forging hydraulic press (type shown in Figure 1b of JB/T 1222.9-2015).

The double-column forging hydraulic press should be arranged near one side of the column axis of the factory building. The moving direction of the movable working table is determined as the longitudinal direction of the hydraulic press, and the direction of the anvil's transverse movement perpendicular to the movable working table is determined as the transverse direction of the hydraulic press. The angle between the center line connecting the two columns and the center line of the anvil's transverse movement is the oblique angle α of the frame.

The appropriate oblique angle α should meet the requirements of the lateral clearance distance of the columns specified in Table 4-113; it should also take into account the longitudinal clearance distance of the columns, maximize the allowable eccentric distances in both the lateral and longitudinal directions, and it is advisable to set the anvil's transverse movement device between the columns; it should facilitate the operator in the control room to observe the state of the anvil and the forging held by the operation machine on the hydraulic press, and consider the accessibility of the main hook of the crane.

The length of the movable working table should at least meet the needs of arranging the upsetting table and a pair of anvils, and there should be an appropriate interval distance between the anvil tools. The stroke of the movable working table should meet the needs of moving the anvil tools out of the hydraulic press for convenient replacement of anvil tools, loading and unloading of forgings, and other auxiliary operations by the crane. It can be selected to have equal strokes in both directions, or different strokes towards and away from the operation machine side.

According to the needs of the forging process of the product, adjustments can be made to the size and stroke of the working table surface; the thickness dimension of the working table should refer to Appendix A of JB/T12229-2015. An upper anvil pad should be installed between the lower plane of the movable crossbeam or the upper beam of the integral frame and the upper anvil, and its thickness dimension should refer to Appendix A of JB/T12229-2015.

Under normal forging conditions, the working speed of the hydraulic press should comply with the regulations in Table 4-113. The working speed value under upsetting conditions should be separately specified in the contract or agreement.

Both the normal forging frequency and the finishing frequency are calculated values of the number of working cycles per minute of the hydraulic press, and are related to parameters such as the pressing amount, return amount, and their corresponding working speeds. Among them, the pressing amount has a wide selection range and is closely related to factors such as the rated force of the hydraulic press, forging material, deformation process, operation method, etc. During hot normal forging, it is generally calculated based on the pressing amount usually used in the forging process; during hot finishing, the minimum pressing amount can generally be selected within 3-30 mm.

For the forging capacity of the double-column forging hydraulic press and its matching with the main parameters of the forging operation machine, please refer to Appendix B of JB/T12229-2015.

2. Technical Requirements

(1) General Technical Requirements

1) The general technical conditions of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of JB/T18229 and JB/T3818.

2) The scope of equipment for the double-column forging hydraulic press includes: the hydraulic press body (including the upper anvil rotation and quick-change device), hydraulic transmission and control system (including the pump station, operation valve and pipelines, etc.), electrical transmission and control system (including the control cabinet, operation panel and pipelines, etc.), lubrication system, special tools, a pair of upper and lower flat anvils and their bases, and necessary consumables.

3) The mechanized equipment and auxiliary devices of the double-column forging hydraulic press (such as the anvil's transverse movement device, anvil library, ingot rotation lifting platform or ingot transfer trolley, forging temperature measurement device, etc.) and other forging tools (such as various special-shaped anvil tools, rotating forging table, and spare parts, etc.) can be selected according to actual production needs.

4) The working environment temperature of the double-column forging hydraulic press (including the pump station) can be 5-40 ℃, with a relative humidity of less than or equal to 85%, and an altitude of less than 2500 m. If there are special working environment requirements, they should be clearly stated in the technical agreement.

5) Within 12 months from the day of the load test acceptance of the double-column forging hydraulic press, if damage occurs due to design and manufacturing reasons under the conditions of correct use, normal maintenance and care, the manufacturer should provide free corresponding repair or part replacement (except for consumables).

6) After the double-column forging hydraulic press is put into use, under the conditions of correct use and normal maintenance and care, the first comprehensive overhaul should be arranged after 28,500 hours of load work or between 4-6 years of use.

7) The product manual of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comprehensively provide product knowledge and usage methods suitable for the expected function, which should include important information related to the safety and economical use of the hydraulic press, as well as the drawings and technical documents provided with the product. This information should help prevent dangers, reduce maintenance costs and downtime, and improve the reliability and service life of the hydraulic press.

(2) Safety and Environmental Protection

1) The safety and health design of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB50083.

2) The safety protection of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB17120 and JB/T3915 (which has been abolished).

3) The hydraulic transmission and control system of the double-column forging hydraulic press should be equipped with overload safety protection devices.

4) The safety requirements of the electrical transmission and control system of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB522261.

5) The double-column forging hydraulic press and its mechanized equipment and auxiliary devices should be equipped with safety interlocking control and stroke limit protection devices.

6) The double-column forging hydraulic press should be equipped with emergency stop buttons on the operation panel in the control room, the control system, the pump station, and other locations.

7) The noise limit value of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB26484.

8) The measurement methods for the noise sound pressure level and sound power level of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB/T23281 and GB/T23282.

9) The scrap or leaked working medium of the double-column forging hydraulic press should be entrusted to a qualified professional company for recycling and treatment, or processed according to the requirements of the local environmental protection department. It is prohibited to burn it by oneself or dump, abandon, and discharge it at will.

10) The double-column forging hydraulic press uses mineral oil hydraulic oil as the working medium.

In addition, the following requirements should be followed:

① Pressurized charging tanks should be filled with nitrogen or other inert gases and should preferably be installed in the pump station or below ground level.

② An emergency quick shut-off valve should be installed on the charging outlet pipe of the charging tank, or an emergency quick vent valve should be installed on the gas side of the charging tank, and should be interlocked with the emergency stop button on the control panel.

⑤ Oil tanks, flanges, joints, and valve blocks on the top of the hydraulic press should be designed with anti-spray oil facilities.

⑥ Reliable oil leakage collection devices should be installed for each working cylinder, pump station, valve block, pipeline, etc.

⑦ The product manual should clearly list fire safety guidelines and propose engineering design requirements for fire alarm installation, and prevention of fire spread and expansion.

(3) Strength and stiffness conditions of the frame

1) Double-column forging hydraulic presses should use computer three-dimensional finite element (FEM) analysis to calculate and analyze the stress and deformation of the frame, especially paying attention to the optimization design of high stress concentration areas (such as sand hole, transition fillet, and sections with drastic changes).

2) The equivalent stress and stiffness values of the frame can be taken as the values specified in Table 4-114. Among them, the stiffness of the upper and lower beams is expressed as the deflection per meter span between the center distances of the columns in the wide face, and the column stiffness is the deflection in the horizontal direction of the column under the condition of elongation and within the allowable forging eccentricity.

3) The tie rods in the combined frame should be designed with high-strength multi-tie rod design, while single tie rods can also be used for small (nominal force less than or equal to 25 MN) or other special structural design double-column forging hydraulic presses.

4) The shortest length of the lower beam in the direction of movement of the worktable should be able to withstand the pressing force during core bar reaming, and its length value can be found in Appendix A of JB/T12229-2015.

(4) Manufacturing and performance of key components

1) The upper beam, movable beam, lower beam, column, and frame in the overall frame of the combined frame are generally manufactured with low alloy steel castings specified in JB/T6402, and should be subjected to stress relief heat treatment. After rough machining, secondary heat treatment should also be performed. Select appropriate materials and ReL values according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor should be 2 to 2.5 (take the upper limit for small hydraulic presses and the lower limit for large hydraulic presses). The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the standards used (selected materials).

2) The tie rods in the combined frame are generally manufactured with alloy structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6396, and should be subjected to quenching and tempering heat treatment. Select appropriate materials and ReL values according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor should be 2.5 to 3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the selected material standards. The inspection items and sampling quantity should meet the requirements of Level V of the forgings acceptance grouping specified in JB/T50008-2007.

3) The main (side) cylinder and return cylinder are generally manufactured with alloy structural steel forgings specified in GB/T15591, NB/T47008, and JB/T6396, or carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6397. They can also be manufactured by welding method with split forgings. The forgings should be subjected to quenching and tempering heat treatment. Select appropriate materials and ReL values according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor should be greater than or equal to 3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the standards used (selected materials). The inspection items and sampling quantity should meet the requirements of Level V of the forgings acceptance grouping specified in JB/T50008-2007, and the tangential mechanical properties ReL, Rm, Z, A, and Ak should be inspected for each piece.

4) The main cylinder plunger of the column is generally manufactured with alloy structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6369 or carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6397, and should be subjected to corresponding heat treatment. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the selected material standards. The surface of the plunger should be hardened, and the hardness of the working surface should not be lower than 45 HRC. The thickness of the hardened layer should be greater than 3 mm.

5) The surface hardness of the column guide plate should not be lower than 400 HBW.

6) The tensile strength of the sliding plate material on the lower beam should be well matched with the sliding plate under the movable worktable.

2) The general technical conditions of non-ferrous metal castings for products should meet the requirements of JB/T50005.

2. Technical Requirements

(1) Basic Requirements
1) The electro-hydraulic hammer should comply with the provisions of JB/T1829 and GB/T2571910 standards, and be manufactured according to approved drawings and technical documents.
2) Cast iron parts should comply with JB/T5775, and welded parts should comply with JB/T8609.
3) The instruction manual should comply with GB/T9969.
4) Important forgings should undergo ultrasonic testing (such as hammer rod, hammer head, anvil block, etc.). The ultrasonic testing should comply with JB/T8467, and relevant records should be maintained.
5) The random spare parts and accessories of the electro-hydraulic hammer should be interchangeable and comply with relevant technical documents.
6) All fasteners used in the electro-hydraulic power head and frame should be equipped with anti-loosening measures. The power head and frame should be provided with vibration damping pads.

(2) Type and Basic Parameters
The type and basic parameters of the electro-hydraulic hammer should comply with GB/T25718, except for special requirements from users.

(3) Performance
1) The operating system of the electro-hydraulic hammer should be safe, reliable, and flexible.
2) Free forging electro-hydraulic hammers and die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be able to achieve hammer head lifting, holding, heavy striking, light striking, slow lowering, pressing, and emergency stop functions. By changing the lifting height of the hammer head, the striking energy of the electro-hydraulic hammer can be altered. CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers can achieve lifting, heavy striking, light striking, and slow lowering functions. By adjusting the closing time of the striking valve, the striking energy of the electro-hydraulic hammer can be precisely controlled to meet the requirements of the forging process. The striking energy control accuracy of CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be ±3%.
3) The moving parts of the electro-hydraulic hammer, such as the hammer head system (welded hammer head and hammer rod), should be flexible and free of jamming within the effective stroke.
4) During normal use of free forging electro-hydraulic hammers and die forging electro-hydraulic hammers, the hammer should be able to lift the hammer head from the closed position to any position within the stroke height. If striking is not immediately performed, a slight sliding of the suspended hammer head is allowed, but the sliding distance within 5 seconds should not exceed 10 mm.
5) In the instant of striking with free forging electro-hydraulic hammers and die forging electro-hydraulic hammers, if a misoperation is detected, an immediate emergency stop should be possible. This anti-misoperation function should only be used in emergency situations.
6) During the slow lowering process, CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should operate in a jog mode. The sliding distance within 5 seconds in the stopped state should not exceed 5 mm.
7) A return stop device should be installed to ensure that the hammer head system does not experience rigid impact at the maximum return speed.
8) When required by the user, die forging electro-hydraulic hammers and CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be equipped with an ejector device. The ejecting force should be at least 10 times the weight of the hammer head.
9) Adjusting the striking energy of CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be convenient. After replacing different dies, the die closing height parameters should be re-entered, and the striking energy should be automatically adjusted.

(4) Appearance
1) The appearance quality of the electro-hydraulic hammer should comply with JB/T1829.
2) After removing sand, adhering sand, scabs, and excess material from the external surface of castings, the flatness of the unmachined surface should be checked using a 500 mm straight edge. The deviation should not exceed 2.5 mm.
3) After removing rust, sand, and oil stains from unmachined external surfaces, depending on the surface condition, priming, puttying, and painting should be performed. The anvil base and embedded parts should only be painted with anti-rust paint. Riveted and welded parts may not be puttied. The putty thickness should not exceed 1.5 mm, and local thickening should not exceed 3 mm.

4.2.3.7 Hydraulic universal testing machine
The hydraulic universal testing machine is a universal testing machine that uses a hydraulic system to apply force and measure force for testing. GB/T 26111-2007 "General Technical Conditions for Testing Machines" stipulates the basic requirements for testing machines, and also stipulates the requirements for assembly and mechanical safety, machined parts, castings and welded parts, electrical equipment, hydraulic equipment, appearance quality, and random technical documents, which are applicable to metal material testing machines, non-metal material testing machines, balancing machines, vibration tables, impact tables and collision test tables, force and deformation measuring instruments, process testing machines, packaging testing machines, and non-destructive testing instruments (hereinafter collectively referred to as testing machines).
Note: The universal testing machine is a material testing machine that can perform tensile, compression, bending tests, and more than three kinds of tests. Universal testing machines have mechanical, hydraulic, electronic, and electro-hydraulic servo types; they can measure the bending strength, deflection, and other mechanical properties of materials; they can also perform "cold bending (or hot bending) tests" for the ductility test of material bending deformation. This type of test belongs to the process performance test.
Among them, the requirements for hydraulic equipment (i.e., Chapter 8 of GB/T 26111-2007) are as follows:
1) The working surfaces of parts such as pistons, hydraulic cylinders, and valves in the hydraulic system shall not have cracks or scratches.
2) The hydraulic transmission part should not produce vibration, impact, and stagnation beyond the specified range within the working speed range.
3) The hydraulic system should be equipped with an exhaust device and reliable sealing, and there should be no oil leakage.
4) The structure and shape of the oil tank should meet the following requirements:
① Under normal working conditions, it should be able to accommodate all the hydraulic oil flowing from the system.
② Prevent the polluted hydraulic oil that overflows and leaks from directly returning to the oil tank.
③ The shape at the bottom of the oil tank should allow the hydraulic oil to be completely discharged.
④ The oil tank should be easy to clean and be equipped with an oil filling port and an oil discharge port.
⑤ The oil tank should be equipped with an oil level indicator.
5) The hydraulic system should be provided with waterproof and dustproof measures. To eliminate harmful impurities in the hydraulic oil, a filter device should be installed to make the hydraulic oil reach the specified cleanliness. Systems containing servo valves and proportional valves should be equipped with non-bypass filters at the pressure oil port.
6) Sufficient space should be left at the installation position of the filter device for replacement.
7) The outlets of all return oil pipes and drain oil pipes should be below the oil level to prevent foam generation and air entry.
8) When the working pressure or flow in the hydraulic system loop exceeds the specified value and may cause danger or accidents, a protection device should be provided.
9) The hydraulic transmission part should be equipped with a working stroke limit switch when necessary.
10) When there are one or more interconnected automatic or manual control devices in the hydraulic system, if any failure of any one of them may cause personal injury and equipment damage, an interlock protection device should be installed.
11) When the hydraulic system is in the parking position, if the return of hydraulic oil from valves, pipelines, and actuators to the oil tank will cause equipment damage or danger, measures should be taken to prevent the hydraulic oil from returning to the oil tank.

2. Electro-hydraulic servo static and dynamic universal testing machine

The electro-hydraulic servo static and dynamic universal testing machine is a testing machine that uses an electro-hydraulic servo control system to apply both static and dynamic forces, combining the functions of an electronic universal testing machine and a fatigue testing machine. JB/T8612-2015 stipulates the symbols and descriptions, main parameter series, technical requirements, inspection methods, inspection rules, markings, and packaging of the electro-hydraulic servo static and dynamic universal testing machine for conducting static and dynamic mechanical property tests on metallic and non-metallic materials (hereinafter referred to as the testing machine).

The normative references in JB/T8612-2015 include GB/T26111-2007 "General Technical Requirements for Testing Machines," GB/T16825.1-2008 "Verification of Static Uniaxial Testing Machines Part 1: Verification and Calibration of Force-Measuring Systems of Tension and/or Compression Testing Machines," GB/T25917-2010 "Dynamic Force Calibration of Axial Force Fatigue Testing Machines," and JB/T6146-2007 "Extensometer Technical Conditions," etc.

JB/T8612-2015 deletes the grading of testing machines.

(1) Main parameter series of the testing machine

The main parameter of the testing machine is the maximum static test force, and the specifications of the testing machine are divided according to the main parameter, which also characterizes the maximum capacity of the testing machine. The main parameter of the testing machine should be selected according to the provisions of Table 4-133.

The electro-hydraulic servo cement pressure testing machine is a pressure testing machine that uses a hydraulic system to apply force and uses electronic measurement and hydraulic servo control technology to perform compression tests on cement and other building materials and their products. JB/T 8763—2013 specifies the technical requirements, inspection methods, inspection rules, marking and packaging, and accompanying documents of electro-hydraulic cement pressure testing machines, applicable to electro-hydraulic cement pressure testing machines with a maximum test pressure not exceeding 300 kN (hereinafter referred to as the testing machine).

4.3 Design and Selection Basis of Hydraulic Cylinders for Shearing Machines and Plate Bending Machines
4.3.1 Shearing Machine
According to the standard JB/T1826.1-1999 "Shearing Machine - Terms and Definitions", a shearing machine is a machine that uses a reciprocating linear motion of one blade relative to another blade to shear sheet metal; a pendulum shearing machine is a shearing machine with a swinging upper blade; a hydraulic shearing machine is a shearing machine driven by hydraulic power; a hydraulic pendulum shearing machine is a pendulum shearing machine driven by hydraulic power. JB/T1826-1991 "Shearing Machine - Types and Basic Parameters" specifies the types and basic parameters of shearing machines; JB/T5197.2-2015 "Shearing Machine - Part 2: Technical Conditions" specifies the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, storage, and manufacturer's guarantee for shearing machines; GB/T1440-2011 "Shearing Machine - Accuracy" specifies the accuracy inspection, allowable values of inspection accuracy, and inspection methods for shearing machines, applicable to general-purpose shearing machines (newly designed).

2) The nameplate shall be fixed properly and firmly in an obvious and suitable position.

1) Gray cast iron shall comply with J B / T 5 7 7 5. Nodular cast iron shall comply with G B / T 1 3 4 8. Cast carbon steel parts shall comply with G B / T 1 1 3 5 2. Defects that do not affect use and appearance are allowed to be repaired according to the provisions of technical documents, provided that the quality is guaranteed. Composite parts used shall comply with the provisions of technical documents. Steel body copper lined composite parts shall comply with J B / T 1 1 1 9 6.

1) The machining of parts shall comply with the requirements of design and process technical documents. The machined surfaces shall not have burrs, spots, and other mechanical damage. Except for special requirements, sharp edges shall be blunted.

2) The design, manufacture, and inspection of pressure vessels shall comply with the provisions of technical documents.

1) The shearing machine should be assembled according to the assembly process specification. All components assembled on the shearing machine should meet quality requirements, and it is not allowed to install gaskets, sleeves, and other parts not specified in the drawing.

The gear transmission mechanism, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic components of the shearing machine should produce uniform sound during operation, without irregular impact sounds and periodic sharp noises. The noise of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of GB2438389.
(13) Appearance
1) The outer surface of the shearing machine should not have protrusions, depressions, or roughness that are not specified in the drawing. The edges of the joint surfaces of components should be neat and uniform, and the allowable deviation should comply with the provisions of relevant standards.
2) Countersunk screws should not protrude from the outer surface of the part, positioning pins should generally protrude slightly from the outer surface of the part, and the protrusion value should be equal to the chamfer value; the end of the bolt should protrude beyond the nut, and the protrusion value should not be greater than 1/5 of its diameter; the exposed shaft end should protrude beyond the end face of its enclosing part, and the protrusion value should be approximately equal to the chamfer value.
3) The outer machined surfaces of the main components of the shearing machine should not have marks such as bumps, scratches, or rust.
4) The installation of various pipe and wiring systems should be neat and beautiful, and should not cause friction or collision with other components. The bent parts of the pipes should be smooth.
5) The painting of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
4. Testing Method for Shearing Machine
(1) Basic Parameter Inspection
1) The basic parameter inspection of the shearing machine should be carried out under no-load conditions, and the basic parameters of the shearing machine should meet the design requirements.
2) For batch-produced standard shearing machines, sampling inspection is allowed, and the number of samples should not be less than 10%, and not less than one machine.
3) The allowable deviation of the shearing machine parameters should comply with the provisions of Table 4-136.

(2) Load Test
1) Each shearing machine should undergo a full-load test, and the number of tests should not be less than 2 times. During the full-load test, the thickness and length of the sheared plate should be equal to the maximum thickness and width that can be sheared, and metal plates with Rm of 450 MPa should be used. For batch-produced shearing machines, sampling inspection can be carried out according to 4.(1)2).
2) For new or updated products, overload test should be conducted during trial production and appraisal. The shearing machine with mechanical transmission should be tested at 120% of its shearing force, and the shearing machine with hydraulic transmission should be tested at no more than 110% of the rated pressure, and the number of tests should not be less than 3 times. During the overload test, the test can be carried out by shearing metal plates or loading with a loading device.
3) All mechanisms and working systems of the shearing machine should operate in a coordinated and reliable manner during the load test, and the overload protection device should be sensitive and reliable.
(3) Precision Inspection
1) The shearing machine should undergo precision inspection after the full-load test.
2) The precision inspection of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T14404.

5. Accuracy Inspection Requirements for Shearing Machine
(1) General Requirements
1) The inspection conditions shall meet the requirements of power supply voltage fluctuation within ±10% and ambient temperature within 5~40°C.
2) Before the accuracy inspection of the shearing machine, its installation levelness shall be adjusted. Place the level gauge at the middle, left and right positions of the worktable along the longitudinal and transverse directions of the shearing machine. The readings of the level gauge shall not exceed 0.20/1000.
3) During the inspection process, the components and parts affecting accuracy shall not be adjusted.
4) The accuracy inspection and measuring tools for inspection shall comply with the relevant provisions of GB/T109923.
5) When the actual measured length is less than the length specified in the tolerance, it shall be converted according to the actual measured length, and the converted result shall be rounded off to the number of micrometers according to GB/T8170.
6) For the shearing machine with the upper tool holder making inclined reciprocating motion, the "parallelism of the vertical supporting surface in contact with the lower blade to the stroke of the upper tool holder" shall not be inspected.
7) For the swing-type shearing machine, the "parallelism of the vertical supporting surface in contact with the lower blade to the stroke of the upper tool holder" and the "parallelism of the vertical supporting surface in contact with the upper blade to the stroke of the upper tool holder" shall not be inspected.
